However, existing LLM-based news-forecasting pipelines face two practical limitations: relevant news articles often exceed the model's context window, and iterative retrieval of supplementary news is typically unguided, leading to redundant updates and slow convergence. We address these issues with a novel framework that combines importance-aware news compression and process-level retrieval supervision. First, we train an importance reward model that estimates the forecasting utility of each article and uses this signal to allocate compression budgets during sequential pairwise fusion, preserving informative content within a fixed context limit. Second, we introduce a process reward model (PRM) that ranks multiple supplementary-news candidates conditioned on the current error profile and the history of previously selected articles, replacing one-shot blind retrieval with quality-controlled selection. Both components are trained offline using historical data with ground truth; inference uses the frozen filtering logic and compression modules without any reflection loop. Experiments on finance, energy, traffic, and bitcoin forecasting benchmarks show that our method improves prediction accuracy over strong baselines, significantly reduces the number of refinement iterations compared to the iterative baseline, and remains effective when relevant articles span thousands of tokens.

</details>


### [307] [DeskCraft: Benchmarking Desktop Agents on Professional Workflows and Human-in-the-Loop Collaboration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03103)
*Wenkai Wang,Tao Xiong,Jingchen Ni,Yunpeng Bao,Xiyun Li,Tianqi Liu,Hongcan Guo,Zilong Huang,Shengyu Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: DeskCraft 是一个针对桌面 GUI 智能体的执行型基准测试，包含 538 个任务，专注于专业创意与工程软件中的长时程工作流和人在环路（human-in-the-loop）协作。它提出 L1/L2/L3 难度分层（其中 L3 任务需超过 50 个执行步骤），并形式化了一个由 agent_ask、step_count、agent_done 三种可组合触发器构成的人机交互协议（涵盖 mid-turn 与 post-turn 交互）。在 18 个专有与开源智能体上的评估显示，最强的 GPT-5.4 在标准任务上仅达 31.6%，交互任务上仅 27.6%；当前智能体在 L3 工作流交付、主动澄清以及被打断后的重规划方面存在显著短板。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有桌面 GUI 基准（如 OSWorld、WAA、macOSWorld）大多将任务简化为"一次性给出完整指令的短时程原子任务"，无法反映真实专业工作流的两大核心特征：(1) 长时程、跨多应用的复杂交付流程（如 3D 渲染管线从建模到灯光、渲染、合成的多阶段任务）；(2) 人在环路协作（用户中途澄清、中断、完成后的反馈与修订）。该工作旨在填补这一空白，提供一个可同时评估长时程执行能力与动态人机协作能力的桌面基准。

Method: 1. **任务形式化**：将任务定义为 τ = (s₀, u₀, Φ, ℰ, R)，其中 Φ 是可选的交互阶段序列；智能体在每步观察截图并选择动作 a ∈ 𝒜 ∪ {DONE, ASK, FAIL}。
2. **L1/L2/L3 难度分层**：L1 为原子操作；L2 为 2-4 个相关操作的组合；L3 为来自真实专业交付流程的长时程任务（超 50 步），保留实际任务的依赖结构而非简单串联原子操作。
3. **人机交互协议**：用三种可组合触发器实现 mid-turn 与 post-turn 交互——agent_ask（智能体在不确定时主动询问）、step_count（模拟用户中断）、agent_done（用户验证后提供后续指令）。配合 MLLM 用户模拟器实现确定性评估。
4. **执行型验证器**：针对每类应用构建领域感知的验证器库，从项目文件或应用运行时提取结构化状态并应用基于规则检查（如 Blender 通过 bpy 脚本查询场景图、Audacity 分析 WAV 信号特征、SVG 解析 XML 节点）。
5. **基准构建**：从官方文档与教程中系统化收集 224 个参考源形成能力矩阵；任务来源含 52.8% 官方文档、27.2% 作者设计、7.5% 教程、5.2% Web 资源；通过 LLM 生成 + 人工/AI 双重评审保证评估函数质量。

Result: **RQ1（标准与交互设置下的整体表现）**：在 386 个标准任务上，最强的 Kimi-K2.6 平均成功率 33.8%，GPT-5.4 为 31.6%；在 152 个交互任务上 GPT-5.4 达 27.6%，Kimi-K2.6 达 25.7%。多数开源 VLM 与 GUI 专用模型显著更低（如 Qwen3-VL-8B 仅 3.2%/2.1%，OS-Atlas-Pro-7B 几乎为 0）。**RQ2（长时程 300 步预算分析）**：Kimi-K2.6 在 25 步时仅 17.0%，100 步时达 34.3%，150 步时为 34.9%，181 步时为 35.7%；200 步后无新增成功，说明延长时间预算能恢复少量长尾能力但收益有限。**RQ3（难度退化）**：L1→L3 性能显著下降，EvoCUA-32B 从 L1 的 19.9% 降至 L3 的 1.0%；GPT-5.4 从 L2 的 40.7% 降至 L3 的 9.5%，Kimi-K2.6 从 41.0% 降至 21.6%；平均运行步数从 L1 的 30.8 升至 L3 的 77.7（Kimi-K2.6）。**RQ4（人在环路分析）**：智能体在"纠错/反馈"类任务上表现最好（用户给出具体修改指引），在"中断"类任务上表现较差（需重规划），在"主动询问"类任务上成功率最低——表明当前智能体倾向于过度承诺于初始猜测而非主动澄清。Pass@k 分析显示多次运行能提升上限（Kimi-K2.6 在 k=6 时从 28.7% 升至 45.6%），但 pass^k 下降，说明运行间一致性弱。

Conclusion: DeskCraft 揭示了桌面 GUI 智能体从"执行简单指令"到"持续工作流规划与主动人机协作"的能力断层。当前最强模型在专业长时程工作流和交互任务上仍远不可靠，其核心瓶颈已从单步执行转向：(1) 多应用跨阶段工作流的交付能力；(2) 被打断后的状态保持与重规划；(3) 在信息不足时主动寻求澄清而非过度承诺。交互协议为该方向提供了可控、可复现且确定性的评估手段，可作为推进真实可部署桌面智能体研究的诊断工具。局限性包括语言覆盖仍不完整（仅中英）、用户模拟器采用脚本化消息以保证可复现性而无法完全捕捉真实人类协作的多样性、且基准任务集与步骤预算仍是真实工作流的有限切片。

Abstract: Real-world professional desktop workflows in specialized creative and engineering software unfold over long horizons and often require human-in-the-loop coordination, where agents proactively seek necessary information and users provide additional instructions, clarifications, feedback, or corrections as the task progresses. Yet existing desktop GUI benchmarks mostly reduce this setting to short, simplified tasks with all user instructions provided upfront. To address this issue, we introduce DeskCraft, a desktop GUI benchmark targeting long horizon creative and engineering workflows and proactive human-agent collaboration. DeskCraft organizes tasks into a multilevel difficulty taxonomy, with long horizon tasks requiring over 50 execution steps, and covers professional creative software across design, video, audio, and 3D creation. Furthermore, DeskCraft formalizes human-agent collaboration into an interaction protocol covering mid-turn and post-turn exchanges. Mid-turn interaction captures both agent-initiated clarification under uncertainty and user-initiated interruption during execution, while post-turn interaction accommodates user-driven feedback after the agent signals completion, together spanning the full space of realistic collaboration patterns. We evaluate 18 proprietary and open source agents on 538 tasks and find that GPT-5.4 reaches 31.6% on standard tasks and 27.6% on interactive tasks. Further analyses reveal persistent failures in long horizon workflow delivery and proactive clarification. We will open-source all evaluation codes, tasks, and data at this https URL .

</details>


### [308] [EvoTrainer: Co-Evolving LLM Policies and Training Harnesses for Autonomous Agentic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03108)
*Guhong Chen,Yingcheng Shi,Yongbin Li,Binhua Li,Xander Xu,Hu Wei,Shiwen Ni,Min Yang,Jieping Ye*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: EvoTrainer提出了一种自主训练框架,通过协同进化LLM策略和训练侧诊断工具集(训练harness),在数学推理、竞争性编程和仓库级软件工程等智能体RL任务上达到或超过人工设计的RL基线,最大提升出现在长时程SWE任务(SWE-9B达38.16% vs 人工RL 33.77%)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的自主LLM训练系统主要将训练视为"配方搜索"(recipe search),训练harness(诊断工具、记忆、干预逻辑)保持静态。这种限制在智能体RL中尤为突出:瓶颈会随版本变化而漂移,标量奖励会掩盖奖励泄漏、不健康行为等多样失败模式。EvoTrainer将训练harness本身视为进化对象,使其能够跨训练版本自适应地解释rollout证据并指导干预。

Method: 双进化机制:(1)策略自进化——生成可运行的训练版本,经受控干预进行比较、剪枝、提升和合并;(2)训练器自反思——当现有指标、分析器、回测或搜索程序不足时进化训练侧harness。核心组件包括:基于rollout证据的信号诊断、harness修订、持久记忆、可复用技能库。训练器智能体自主运行"构造版本→诊断结果→修订harness→提出干预"循环,人类仅负责初始化工作区并批准高成本或关键性执行。区别于针对推理侧harness的方法(Meta-Harness、AHE),EvoTrainer针对的是训练时RL产物(奖励分布、组方差、行为轨迹、死组比、跨版本干预证据)。

Result: 在Math、Coding、SWE三大领域上,EvoTrainer均超过无RL基线,并在相同数据、代码库和评估协议下匹配或超过人工RL参考。最大增益出现在长时程智能体SWE:SWE-9B达38.16 BC%,而无RL为30.19,人工RL为33.77(+4.39 BC%绝对提升)。过程级分析表明:各领域保留的策略存在分化,进化式harness能拒绝无效的高分分支,可复用技能影响后续搜索方向,提供超越纯分数驱动的证据。

Conclusion: EvoTrainer是首个在智能体LLM RL中将训练侧诊断harness本身作为进化对象的自主训练框架。论文主张:自主LLM RL应超越静态的"配方搜索"范式,走向策略与"解读策略的训练harness"的联合进化。该工作将训练系统本身作为改进对象,提出跨版本训练器改进的新视角,为智能体RL中版本特定失败模式的自适应诊断提供了新方向。

Abstract: Autonomous LLM training is often framed as recipe search, which leaves the training harness largely static. This limitation sharpens in agentic RL, where shifting bottlenecks and scalar rewards mask diverse failure modes. We introduce EvoTrainer, an autonomous training framework that co-evolves LLM policies and training-side harnesses through empirical feedback: it diagnoses rollout-level evidence, revises diagnostics, backtests interventions, and accumulates reusable skills. Evaluated on mathematical reasoning, competitive-programming code generation, and repository-level software engineering, EvoTrainer matches or exceeds the human-engineered RL references under the same data, codebase, and evaluation protocol, with the largest gain on long-horizon agentic SWE. Trajectory analyses show that retained strategies diverge across domains, evolving diagnostics prevent invalid high-scoring branches from being promoted, and reusable skills shape later search. Autonomous LLM RL should move beyond recipe search toward joint evolution of policies and the training harnesses that interpret them.

</details>


### [309] [Uncertainty-Aware Clarification in LLM Agents with Information Gain](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03135)
*Mengyi Deng,Zhiwei Li,Xin Li,Tingyu Zhu,Ying Zhao,Zhijiang Guo,Wei Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向LLM智能体的目标驱动澄清框架，通过信息增益奖励（Information Gain Reward）量化澄清问题的效用，利用贝叶斯信念更新衡量澄清交换对真实用户目标的概率质量偏移，并结合DAPO算法训练澄清策略。在τ-Bench上的实验表明，该方法在五个异构智能体主干上平均成功率提升3.7%，平均仅增加0.3个交互步骤。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体在用户指令不明确（underspecified）时容易产生错误的工具调用。现有训练流程对澄清行为的监督存在不对齐问题——通常仅奖励表层流畅性而无法捕捉问题减少需求不确定性的能力，导致模型倾向于生成通用、安全但信息量低的问题。本文旨在超越主观监督，将澄清问题重新定义为不确定性感知学习中的信息获取问题。

Method: 1. **环境与协议**：在τ-Bench（POMDP框架）基础上引入可插拔的LLM澄清器模块，在智能体工具调用后评估执行反馈是否暴露潜在歧义。2. **摊销贝叶斯实验设计（Amortized BED）**：将澄清问题建模为对潜在目标G*的贝叶斯信念更新，定义信息增益奖励R_t为长度归一化的后验与先验对数似然之差（即teacher-forced log P(G*|x,Q,A) - log P(G*|x)），数学上等价于Pointwise Mutual Information。3. **严格用户模拟器**：训练时使用严格模拟器，仅当问题具体相关时才揭示任务信息，防止奖励黑客。4. **DAPO优化**：对每个上下文采样K个候选问题，计算组内相对优势，使用非对称裁剪的DAPO目标函数进行策略优化。5. **数据构造**：从τ-Bench轨迹中提取2,676个步级实例，对原始目标进行LLM重写（第一人称化、JSON扁平化、噪声去除）得到规范化的G*。

Result: **消融实验**（Qwen3-1.7B）：完整方法在retail上从16.5%提升至18.3%，airline上从13.3%提升至17.3%，平均澄清次数从4.2降至1.3；移除信息增益项或使用LLM-as-a-Judge均导致airline域性能大幅下降（分别降至10%和8%）。**边界探索**：1.7B专门训练模型（17.8%）接近最佳大模型DeepSeek-V3.1（18.1%），仅差0.3%，且澄清次数远少（1.3 vs 3.9-5.1）。**跨智能体泛化**：在Qwen3-8B/32B、DeepSeek-R1/V3.2、GLM-4-32B上均稳定提升，平均成功率从23.6%提升至27.3%（+3.7%），airline域提升5.4%；更强智能体获得更大增益（DeepSeek-V3.2提升6.4%）。**澄清预算**：澄清次数与成功率呈非单调关系，中间预算最优，过度澄清会引入上下文污染。训练动力学显示信息增益奖励单调上升，KL散度和梯度范数平稳。

Conclusion: 该工作提出了信息增益驱动的澄清器增强框架，通过贝叶斯信念更新量化澄清效用，结合DAPO优化澄清时机与内容。实验在训练动态、澄清边界、触发频率和跨智能体泛化四个维度验证了方法的鲁棒性，以极低的交互开销（平均0.3步）实现3.7%的成功率提升。未来方向包括：弱监督信号下的学习（无需真实目标）、联合优化智能体与澄清器、以及将澄清建模为选择性路由能力而非始终开启的对话行为。

Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents often operate under underspecified user instructions, where latent uncertainty over user intent leads to erroneous tool actions. To address this challenge, we propose a goal-oriented clarification framework that aligns clarification behavior with ambiguity resolution. Central to our approach is the Information Gain Reward, a metric that quantifies the utility of clarification questions by measuring the Bayesian belief update towards the ground-truth goal induced by the clarification exchange. We train the clarifier (LLM) using this reward to optimize for high information gain, ensuring that clarifications effectively reduce uncertainty and improve task completion within the agent-tool-user environment. We validate our framework within a clarification-enhanced $\tau$-Bench environment, conducting cross-agent evaluations across five heterogeneous backbones. Empirical results demonstrate that our method consistently improves the success rate by 3.7\% over the no-clarification baseline, while adding only 0.3 total interaction steps on average.

</details>


### [310] [Think-Before-Speak: From Internal Evaluation to Public Expression in Multi-Agent Social Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03137)
*Kaiqi Yang,Tai-Quan Peng,Sanguk Lee,Hui Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: TBS（Think-Before-Speak）是一个基于时间区间的多智能体社会模拟框架，通过分离智能体的内部推理（思考）与公共发言（表达），在镇议会讨论场景中实现"先想后说"的两阶段过程建模，使沉默、发言意愿和公共表达之间的潜藏心理机制变得可观测和可分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的LLM多智能体对话模拟框架主要将交互建模为可观察的轮次交换或聚合输出，忽视了沉默背后持续进行的内部评估过程（如认知失调、感知意见气候、社交孤立风险等）。在镇议会等公共协商场景中，不发言的参与者仍然在持续倾听、评估、修正立场，仅建模可见发言无法捕捉公共表达如何从内部认知中产生的完整路径。

Method: 框架采用离散时间区间协议，包含三个核心组件：（1）智能体模式——包含内部推理模块（含认知失调相关评估、感知意见气候、感知孤立风险、响应策略、发言意愿等结构化内部状态）和发言模块；（2）三段式记忆管理（群体记忆、独白记忆、自我记忆），支持最新保留、随机采样、长尾摘要三种机制；（3）协调器——在每个区间内引导所有智能体思考，根据time_cost（估计响应延迟）竞争发言机会，每区间仅提交一条公共发言。实验在"太阳能光伏强制政策"话题的镇议会讨论中，对比了willing模式（自愿申请发言）与rotation模式（轮流发言）、w/与w/o Force Speak设置、以及三种记忆机制，并使用Six Americas和Balanced Stakeholders两类气候态度人格。分析采用线性混合效应模型检验内部状态动态，以及逻辑斯蒂混合效应模型检验发言意愿与公共表达的关系。

Result: （1）框架生成了内部一致的内部状态轨迹：失调指数（Cronbach's α=.89）和沉默压力指数（α=.92）均表现出强内部一致性；（2）willing模式比rotation模式产生更高的失调水平（b=.130, p=.030）和更高的沉默压力（b=.145, p=.006），且两类指数的增长速率均在willing模式下更快；（3）失调相关评估显著提高发言意愿（OR≈4.34, b=1.47, p<.001），沉默压力显著降低发言意愿（OR≈0.24, b=-1.43, p<.001），呈现"失调作为表达动机、沉默压力作为表达约束"的两阶段机制；（4）一旦形成发言意愿，公共表达主要由发言分配规则决定（willing模式OR≈3.34, b=1.21, p<.001），内部状态对能否实际获得发言机会影响微弱。

Conclusion: TBS通过区间级内部状态追踪、连续记忆更新和竞争性发言分配，验证了公共表达是内部评估过程与外部发言规则共同作用的结果，而非仅仅是模拟协议的直接产出。该框架支持机制敏感的社会模拟，使认知失调、群体压力和沉默螺旋等理论相关过程以可解释的内部状态轨迹、发言意图和公共表达形式变得可观测，为过程层面、可解释且理论驱动的LLM社会模拟提供了新范式。局限在于记忆机制为启发式近似、缺乏心理理论支撑，且实验覆盖话题、模型和智能体规模有限。

Abstract: LLM-based multi-agent simulation offers a promising way to study social interaction, deliberation, and collective opinion dynamics. However, many existing dialogue simulation frameworks represent interaction mainly as observable turn exchange or aggregated outputs, leaving the internal evaluative processes behind silence, speaking intention, and public expression difficult to examine. We introduce TBS (Think-Before-Speak), an interval-based multi-agent simulation framework that separates agents' private reasoning from public utterance generation. At each interval, all agents update structured internal states based on the shared dialogue history and their own memory. These states include dissonance-related appraisal, perceived opinion climate, perceived isolation risk, response strategy, and willingness to speak. The orchestrator then resolves competing speaking intentions and commits one utterance to the public dialogue, allowing internal evaluation and public interaction to co-evolve over time. We evaluate TBS in simulated town hall discussions on a climate-related policy issue. Results show that TBS produces coherent internal-state traces and that these traces vary systematically across turn-allocation, silence, and memory conditions. Dissonance-related appraisal increases agents' willingness to speak, whereas silence-pressure appraisal decreases it. Once speaking intention is formed, public expression is shaped mainly by turn-allocation rules. These findings suggest that TBS supports mechanism-sensitive social simulation by making the pathway from internal evaluation to public expression observable and analyzable.

</details>


### [311] [GTBench: A Curriculum-Grounded Benchmark for Evaluating LLMs as Mathematical Research Assistants in Graph Theory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03144)
*Noujoud Nader,Ibrahem Aljabea,Patrick Diehl,Deepti Gupta*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: GTBench是一个课程导向的图论基准测试，包含63道按难度递增的三组题目（本科基础31题、本科算法21题、研究生证明11题），用于评估GPT-5、Claude Sonnet 4.6、Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite、Llama 3.3 70B和Mistral Large 3在数学研究助手角色下的图论推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM被广泛用作数学自学习工具，其在结构化、多步骤推理领域（尤其是图论这种兼具视觉抽象与组合证明特点的学科）的可靠性尚未被系统评估。现有数学基准（如GSM8K、MATH、FrontierMath、LeanDojo）主要聚焦数值、代数或形式化证明，缺乏针对图论这一离散数学核心领域的课程化评估框架，也未回答"LLM能否作为值得信赖的数学研究助手"这一治理问题。

Method: 从Diestel《Graph Theory》和UPC图论习题集等权威学术来源筛选问题，按四步过滤（图依赖、歧义、无标准答案、组别错配）保留63题。Group 1和2采用精确匹配+GPT-4o作为LLM评判者，Group 3采用三位人类专家与LLM评判者的混合评估协议，使用0/0.5/1评分量表并计算Cohen's κ。所有模型在零样本和思维链（CoT）提示下各运行三次（temperature=0），定义四类失败模式（A-幻觉定义、B-正确算法错误执行、C-错误算法、D-不完整推理）。

Result: 呈现显著性能层级：GPT-5在Group 1达95.8%（零样本）/100%（CoT），Group 3达82%（LLM评判）/81%（人类），是唯一在研究生级证明中保持可用准确率的模型；其他模型随难度增加显著退化，Llama 3.3 70B在Group 3人类评估下为零样本0%。失败模式分析显示Type B（正确算法错误执行）在Group 1和2占主导，Group 3新增Type D（不完整推理）。关键发现：错误回答具有高度一致性（Group 1为95.3%，Group 2为98.6%），表明错误源于模型固有的"自信错误"而非随机波动。CoT提示在Group 1对多数模型无帮助甚至有害，在Group 3效果混合。LLM评判者与人类专家存在系统性分歧（人类间κ=0.48-0.83，LLM-人类κ=0.48-0.64），在冗长或近完整证明上评估尤其不可靠。

Conclusion: GTBench提供了首个面向图论推理的课程化评估框架，揭示当前LLM可支持本科入门和中级图论学习，但研究生级证明构建仍需人类专家验证。错误的高度可复现性是最严峻的警示——研究者可能在无察觉情况下接受自信但错误的答案。未来工作应扩展至更广泛数学领域，采用更细粒度的连续评分方案，并深入探究错误一致性的根源（预训练数据缺口、分布偏差或架构特性），以设计出能让错误可被检测的系统。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as self-study assistants in technical disciplines, yet their reliability as mathematical reasoning assistants remains poorly understood. We introduce GTBench, a curriculum-grounded benchmark for evaluating LLMs as mathematical research assistants in graph theory, comprising 63 problems organized into three groups of increasing difficulty: undergraduate definitions and basic properties (Group 1), algorithm tracing and structural reasoning (Group 2), and graduate-level proof construction (Group 3). Problems are sourced from verified academic materials including Diestel's Graph Theory. We evaluate five frontier models -- GPT-5, Claude Sonnet 4.6, Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite, Llama 3.3 70B, and Mistral Large 3 -- under zero-shot and chain-of-thought prompting, using exact-match and LLM-as-judge evaluation for Groups 1 and 2, and a hybrid human expert and LLM-as-judge protocol for Group 3. Our results reveal a pronounced performance hierarchy: GPT-5 approaches ceiling on Group 1 (95.8% zero-shot) and maintains meaningful accuracy on graduate proofs (82%), while all other models degrade substantially with difficulty, with Llama achieving 0% under human evaluation on Group 3 zero-shot. Failure mode analysis shows that correct algorithm, wrong execution errors dominate Groups 1 and 2, while Group 3 additionally surfaces incomplete reasoning failures and reveals systematic disagreement between human evaluators and the automated judge, particularly on verbose or near-complete proofs (kappa = 0.48-0.83 across human pairs). GTBench provides the first curriculum-grounded evaluation framework for graph-theoretic reasoning in LLMs, with direct implications for the governance of AI tools in mathematical education and scientific research.

</details>


### [312] [ClinicalMC: A Benchmark for Multi-Course Clinical Decision-Making with Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03157)
*Ruihui Hou,Siyi Zhu,Ziyue Huai,Guangya Yu,Yongqi Fan,Chunming Wang,Tong Ruan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了ClinicalMC，一个用于评估大语言模型在多疗程临床决策中表现的中英双语基准测试，包含1,275个中文样本和5,804个英文样本，涵盖从入院到出院的四个阶段（分诊、首程诊疗、多疗程诊疗评估、最终诊断）。作者构建了包含患者、检查者和医生智能体的多智能体评估框架SimHospital，并系统评估了闭源、开源和医学大语言模型在单轮静态和多轮动态设置下的性能，结果显示即使是表现最好的模型也远低于人类水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有临床决策基准主要评估LLM在单疗程场景中的表现，缺乏对患者病情随时间演化的多疗程决策场景的系统评估。真实的临床决策是一个多阶段、迭代的过程，需要持续整合异构数据并根据患者病情变化实时调整诊疗方案，因此亟需一个能反映真实临床实践的复杂多疗程决策基准来评估LLM的能力。

Method: 1. 数据构建：从MedEureka和PMC-Patients收集原始EHR，经过敏感信息脱敏、多轮筛选和分诊处理，构建包含1,275个中文样本和5,804个英文样本的数据集，每个患者平均经历3.42（中文）/5.11（英文）个临床疗程；2. 质量控制：采用三阶段标注流程（GPT-4o自动分割、医学学生检查、临床专家双盲评审），并通过六维度质量评估框架和Cohen's kappa一致性检验确保数据质量（合格率93.3%）；3. 评估框架SimHospital：构建包含患者智能体（提供主诉）、检查者智能体（提供检查结果）和医生智能体（执行分诊、检查建议、诊断、评估、治疗、最终诊断）的多智能体框架；4. 六项临床任务形式化定义：分诊(TR)、检查建议(ER)、临床诊断(CD)、评估(AS)、治疗规划(TP)、最终诊断(FD)；5. 两类实验设置：单轮静态设置（前序任务使用真实标注）和多轮动态设置（使用模型前序输出）；6. 评估四类模型：医学LLM（HuatuoGPT-o1、MedGemma、Baichuan-M2、Apollo2等）、开源LLM（Qwen2.5系列、DeepSeek-V3.2、Llama系列等）、闭源LLM（GPT-5-mini、GPT-4o-mini、Qwen-turbo）以及人类基线。

Result: 1. 所有LLM在ClinicalMC上的表现均显著低于人类水平：英语数据上人类平均分87.51%，最佳模型（Mixtral-8x22B）仅49.80%；中文数据上人类平均分85.00%，最佳模型（Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B）仅48.17%；2. 在多疗程设置下，模型表现明显差于单疗程设置，例如Llama-3.3-70B在中文数据上TP_IoU为6.38%，但CT_IoU仅约2%，原因是临床信息复杂度增加和冗余诊疗干扰；3. 医学LLM并不一定优于通用LLM，如HuatuoGPT-o1(7B)在英文上仅47.77%，表明现有医学专用模型对复杂临床推理支持不足；4. 闭源模型如Qwen-turbo（英文49.68%）表现具有竞争力；5. 错误分析将200个错误样本归为五类：冗余诊疗计划(RDTP)、未能发现细微关键变化(FDSC)、错误临床诊断(ICD)、错误推理链(IRC)及其他错误，其中错误推理链占比最大；6. 动态设置下，英文数据性能下降（错误累积传播），中文数据略有提升（因信息链更短，早期输出可作为后续推理的补充线索）；7. 消融实验表明不同检查者模型对结果排名影响很小，框架具有鲁棒性。

Conclusion: ClinicalMC是首个覆盖完整入院到出院流程、包含多疗程动态决策的中英双语临床决策基准，通过严格的标注质量控制和SimHospital多智能体评估框架，有效弥补了现有基准的不足。实验表明，当前大语言模型（包括医学专用模型）在多疗程临床决策任务上与人类专家存在巨大差距，尤其在多疗程推理、处理冗余信息和持续评估病情变化方面能力不足。该基准为未来医学大语言模型在复杂临床推理、多源信息整合和动态决策调整等方向的研究提供了重要基础。同时，作者指出当前工作的局限性在于缺乏多模态信息和科室分布不均衡，未来将引入医学影像等多模态数据并扩展至多医疗系统以提升泛化能力。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have been widely adopted in healthcare, yet they still encounter significant challenges in complex clinical decision-making scenarios. Existing benchmarks primarily assess LLM performance in single-course settings and lack systematic evaluation in multi-course scenarios, where a patient's condition evolves over time. To address this gap, we propose ClinicalMC, a benchmark for multi-course clinical decision-making. It includes 1,275 Chinese and 5,804 English samples across four stages from admission to discharge. These stages cover triage, first-course examination/diagnosis/treatment, subsequent multi-course examination/assessment/treatment, and final diagnosis. In ClinicalMC, patients in the English dataset undergo an average of 5.11 clinical courses, whereas those in the Chinese dataset undergo 3.42. To assess LLM performance, we construct a multi-agent evaluation framework that includes patient, examiner, and doctor agents. Based on the benchmark and framework, we design two experimental settings -- a single-turn static setting and a multi-turn dynamic setting -- and assess three categories of LLMs: 1) closed-source LLMs like GPT5-mini; 2) open-source LLMs like DeepSeek-V3.2; and 3) medical LLMs like HuatuoGPT-o1. Through extensive evaluation, we aim to better understand LLM performance in the medical domain and support its effective deployment in healthcare.

</details>


### [313] [MedCUA-Bench: A Screenshot-Only Benchmark for Clinical Computer-Use Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03203)
*Jia Yu,Zilong Wang,Xinyang Jiang,Dongsheng Li,Shuo Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MedCUA-Bench是首个面向临床计算机使用代理（CUA）的纯截图交互基准测试，覆盖10个医疗领域中的18个临床场景，包含216个基础任务（432个实例）。基于BrowserGym构建，采用真实产品手册和开源医疗系统（OpenEMR、OHIF Viewer）重建临床GUI，并通过确定性检查器在任务完成度和五个临床安全维度上进行评估。在23个代理的测试中，最佳闭源模型GPT-5.4仅达到54.2%严格成功率，所有模型在真实OpenEMR上均低于9%，开源模型平均仅2.5%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的GUI代理基准（如WebArena、OSWorld、Mind2Web）主要针对通用网页和桌面任务，无法评估医疗GUI代理的可靠性。临床环境具有四大独特挑战：（1）需要领域知识解读患者信息、专业术语和医嘱；（2）遗留布局、密集表单和特殊控件等独特UI设计；（3）受监管、许可和隐私约束的医疗软件难以公开测试；（4）需要超越二元任务完成度的安全验证。通用代理在医疗GUI中的可靠性基本未被验证。

Method: 1. **临床环境构建**：与两位临床医生合作，涵盖门诊、住院、ICU、护理、PACS/病理、影像、放射治疗、心电图、内镜、超声等10个领域。分三个页面保真度层级：15个合成HTML场景（基于产品手册重建）、1个Docker中运行的OpenEMR v7.0.2、2个连接DICOMweb端点的OHIF Viewer场景。2. **配对目标设计**：每个任务提供两种目标粒度——意图级（临床医生委派的高层目标）和步骤级（逐点击的详细程序），用于区分临床推理与UI执行能力。3. **代理接口**：仅基于截图观察，动作空间为BrowserGym像素级接口（鼠标点击、键盘输入等低级操作），禁用DOM、可访问性树和HTML。4. **安全评估**：确定性检查器评估任务完成度和五个安全维度（患者身份、数据准确性、信息保真度、记录完整性、工作流安全），违规按严重程度（critical/major/minor，权重1.0/0.3/0.05）加权，奖励公式为r = clamp(s_task - Σw(v), -1, +1)。5. **评估协议**：所有代理使用统一的AgentLab框架，每个任务实例30步预算，评估23个视觉能力代理（6个闭源+17个开源）。

Result: 最佳闭源模型GPT-5.4达到54.2%严格成功率，Claude-Opus-4.7为52.6%，Claude-Sonnet-4.6为45.4%，Kimi-K2.6为30.8%，GPT-5-Mini为14.6%，Gemini-3.1-Pro仅4.6%。最强开源模型Qwen2.5-VL-32B仅16.2%，开源平均仅2.5%。在真实OpenEMR上所有模型均低于9%。页面保真度分析显示：合成屏幕上模型排名接近总体排序；OpenEMR将所有模型压缩到0-8.3%窄带；OHIF成像层是开源模型接近闭源模型的唯一领域。配对目标分析显示：四个最强闭源模型在步骤目标下均有所提升（GPT-5.4: 51.9%→56.5%），而大多数开源模型在更长的程序提示下表现下降（如Qwen2.5-VL-32B: 18.5%→13.9%）。失败模式分析揭示两种不同失败机制：闭源模型主要为"探索超时"（53.5%），开源模型主要为"格式锁定"（41.3%）和"重度循环"（45.4%）。人类试点基线（24个任务单操作员）达到83.3%成功率，比最强代理高29.1个百分点。

Conclusion: MedCUA-Bench揭示了当前CUA与可靠临床软件使用之间的巨大差距，识别了三个未来研究和训练的关键目标：（1）生产级EHR截图的真实处理能力；（2）更长视野和多种子评估；（3）密集小文本临床界面的处理。基准设计为可重复的测试平台，包含场景、配对目标和确定性安全感知检查器，能够在代理能力提升后继续保持判别力。论文明确指出该基准仅作为研究工具，并非临床部署的认证或安全证明。

Abstract: Computer-use agents could automate repetitive screen-based clinical work, but their reliability in medical graphical user interfaces remains largely unvalidated. Existing benchmarks focus on general web or desktop tasks and underrepresent medical software, which requires domain knowledge, exhibits markedly different UI design from mainstream applications, lacks public testing environments, and demands safety validation beyond task completion. We introduce MedCUA-Bench, an interactive benchmark for clinical computer-use agents. It covers 18 clinical scenarios across 10 medical domains, reconstructed from real product manuals and open-source medical systems to capture authentic clinical interfaces while avoiding licensing and privacy constraints. Each task ships with paired intent- and step-level goals to disentangle clinical reasoning from UI execution, and is evaluated by a deterministic checker over task completion and five clinical safety dimensions. Across 23 agents, the best closed-source model reaches 54.2% strict success, while all models remain below 9% on the real OpenEMR. Open-source agents average only 2.5%, with the best reaching 16.2%. MedCUA-Bench exposes the gap between current agents and reliable clinical software use, providing a reproducible testbed for future research.

</details>


### [314] [Effect of Demographic Bias on Skin Lesion Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03214)
*Ralf Raumanns,Gerard Schouten,Veronika Cheplygina,Josien P.W. Pluim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了皮肤病变分类中人口统计学偏差（性别和年龄）对ResNet-50模型性能的影响，使用线性规划生成可控人口分布的数据集，比较了单任务、强化多任务和对抗学习三种策略的偏差缓解效果，并通过跨数据集验证评估了泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学影像AI模型在不同人口群体（性别、年龄等）之间存在性能差异，可能导致不公平的诊断结果。已有研究多孤立考察单一人口因素，缺乏对训练数据分布的系统性控制，也未在极端分布不平衡条件下系统比较不同去偏策略的有效性。

Method: 1) 使用线性规划（LP）方法从ISIC数据集中精确构建具有可控性别比例（7种分布：M100到F100）和年龄分布（3种方案：YOUNGER/BALANCED/OLDER，5个年龄段）的数据集；2) 实现并比较三种ResNet-50架构：单任务基线模型、强化多任务模型（共享特征+分类+人口属性辅助头）和对抗学习模型（通过负相关损失去除人口特征）；3) 使用平衡测试集评估子组性能差异；4) 分析辅助预测头作为公平性诊断工具的效用；5) 在PAD-UFES-20和DERM7PT两个外部数据集上进行跨数据集验证。

Result: 性别分析：单任务模型在性别偏斜数据上存在显著性能差距；强化模型在平衡和女性为主的场景下可缓解偏差，但在男性为主的场景下效果有限；对抗模型仅在女性主导分布中有效消除偏差。所有模型在男性主导时倾向于过度拟合男性特征。年龄分析：三种模型整体性能相当（0.06 AUC范围内），但所有模型均呈现年龄越大性能越差的趋势，且这种下降在平衡训练数据后仍然存在。辅助头分析显示其在平衡分布下能有效学习人口信号，但在偏斜分布下会崩溃。跨数据集验证（PAD-UFES-20智能手机图像和DERM7PT）显示性能显著下降，域偏移影响模式和偏差表现。

Conclusion: 研究发现性别偏差主要源于训练数据不平衡（可通过多任务或对抗学习部分缓解），而年龄相关的性能下降即使在平衡训练后仍然存在，提示存在固有的生物学或生理学因素。两种偏差机制不同，需要针对性的缓解策略。跨数据集验证表明域偏移（从皮肤镜到智能手机图像）显著影响性能和偏差模式，公平性研究需考虑模态效应与人口偏差的分离。研究强调了在医学影像AI中同时考虑显性因素（数据分布、采样方法）和隐性因素（地理差异、生物学变异）的复杂性。

Abstract: In this study, we evaluate the performance of skin lesion classification using ResNet-based convolutional models, focusing on the impact of demographic bias in training data, particularly variations in patient sex and age. We use linear programming to generate datasets with controlled demographic characteristics, allowing systematic investigation of bias effects. Three learning strategies are evaluated: a single-task model, a reinforcing multi-task model, and an adversarial learning scheme. Our sex-based analysis indicates that sex-specific training datasets optimise model performance. Notably, including male patients in the training data improved performance for the male subgroup, even in female-majority cases. Reinforcing and adversarial learning schemes narrowed or eliminated bias gaps in balanced and female-majority datasets. However, these strategies proved less effective in male-majority settings, where models continued to perform better for males than females. The two learning schemes showed marginal bias reduction compared to the baseline model in predominantly male patient populations. Age-based analysis demonstrates comparable baseline performance across the three model approaches, with performance declining across age categories. Younger groups consistently achieve the highest performance, regardless of training data distribution. Although balanced training yields optimal results for the youngest age category, performance decreases in older categories. We find that sex biases arise mainly from data imbalances, while age biases consistently favour younger groups regardless of distribution. These distinct mechanisms require targeted mitigation strategies. Additionally, cross-dataset validation on two external datasets revealed that domain shifts notably affect performance and patterns of demographic bias.

</details>


### [315] [Perceive Before Reasoning: A Pre-Reasoning Perception Framework for Efficient and Reliable Proactive Mobile Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03236)
*Zhijie Ding,Weinan Hong,Zicheng Zhu,Lei Li,Dezhi Kong,Hao Wang,Peng Zhou,Xuchu Jiang,Jiaming Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了一种面向移动端主动智能助手的两阶段框架 PRPF,通过轻量级多模态感知器(MPP)将"何时介入"的判断与"如何协助"的推理在架构上解耦,显著降低误触发率并提升推理效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于 MLLM 的统一管线在主动移动助手任务中存在两个核心问题:1) 目标错位——"何时介入"需要保守且高判别性的判断,而"如何协助"需要广泛的多模态推理与内容生成,两者目标冲突难以同时优化,导致高误触发率;2) 推理低效——即使最终应保持沉默,单阶段 VLM 智能体仍执行完整推理流程,在 14 种场景、63 个 API 的复杂移动环境下产生大量冗余计算。

Method: PRPF 由两个模块组成:(1) **MPP(多模态主动感知器)**:轻量级多模态融合编码器,采用快-慢双通道结构——慢通道通过注意力池化与 Transformer 编码器建模长期用户行为偏好(用户档案、设备状态、完整 GUI 序列),快通道聚焦最近 4 帧 GUI 截图建模短期动态,两者通过交叉注意力机制增强;含两个 MLP 头,分别用于触发门控(二元 sigmoid + Focal Loss 缓解类别不平衡)和场景预测(多标签 BCE 损失),输出 Top-5 候选函数场景,将函数空间压缩约 68.25%。(2) **PAR(主动智能体推理器)**:基于 Qwen3.5-9B,先经 SFT(8,876 多模态与文本样本)学习结构化输出(ui_summary → thinking → recommendations),再经 GRPO 优化,奖励函数包含准确率奖励、格式奖励与校准奖励,鼓励正确沉默、惩罚误触发。MPP 阈值 τ=0.78,在 Recall≥90% 约束下最大化 Specificity;Top-K 候选池大小 K=5 为召回饱和点。

Result: 在 ProactiveMobile 基准上:1) **整体性能**:ALL SR 从 20.82% 提升至 41.15%,FTR 从 13.76% 降至 7.21%,Type-Acc 从 45.25% 提升至 55.00%;文本设置下 FTR 降至 1.75%。2) **效率**:相比 ProactiveMobile(7B)基线,推理计算量减少 69.3%,端到端延迟减少 60.1%,峰值显存增加 12.0%(因 PAR 使用 9B 模型)。3) **消融实验**:MPP 与 PAR 提供互补增益,慢通道贡献大于快通道,触发门控比函数压缩更重要,SFT 决定基础能力,GRPO 进一步优化决策策略。4) **即插即用**:MPP 可集成至 ProactiveMobile(7B)、GLM-4.6V 等不同模型,均有效降低 FTR 并提升 SR。5) **难度分析**:在 L1/L2/L3 三个难度等级上均稳定领先。6) **失败分析**:多模态场景 SR 仅 17.19%,错误主要集中在"场景误选"(off-scene mismatch,占非空不匹配的 40.6%),尤其是旅行/购物/个人管理等易混淆场景。

Conclusion: PRPF 通过架构层面解耦"何时介入"与"如何协助",在 ProactiveMobile 基准上实现了显著的准确率提升(FTR 降低约一半)与效率提升(计算量减少近 70%),验证了轻量级预推理感知与重推理器分离设计的有效性。MPP 展现出良好的即插即用能力,跨不同下游推理器均能提升性能并抑制误触发。然而,多模态 GUI 理解仍是瓶颈(绝对 SR 较低),且 MPP 依赖 14 个预定义意图场景的标注,跨域扩展需重新训练感知器。未来工作方向包括:更强的视觉定位能力、面向新领域的持续学习或提示式适配器。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have substantially advanced mobile agents, yet proactive mobile assistance remains challenging because agents must decide \emph{when} to intervene before determining \emph{how} to assist. Existing systems often implement these two decisions within a unified MLLM-based pipeline, leading to goal misalignment between conservative intervention filtering and comprehensive assistance generation, as well as redundant inference when the agent should remain silent. To address these limitations, we propose the \textbf{Pre-Reasoning Perception Framework (PRPF)}, a two-stage framework built on perceiving before reasoning. PRPF introduces a lightweight Multimodal Proactive Perceptor (MPP) for intervention gating and context compression, and activates the Proactive Agent Reasoner (PAR) only when intervention is warranted. Experiments on the ProactiveMobile benchmark show that PRPF substantially reduces false trigger rates (FTR) while improving success rates (SR) and inference efficiency over the ProactiveMobile baseline.

</details>


### [316] [Solipsistic Superintelligence is Unlikely to be Cooperative](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03237)
*Rakshit S Trivedi,Natasha Jaques,Logan Cross,Alexander Sasha Vezhnevets,Joel Z Leibo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文主张当前主流的"唯我论"AI研究范式——将世界视为外生、平稳的反馈源——不可能孕育出具有合作能力的超级智能。论文提出"自我颠覆性"概念，论证单边优化在多智能体环境中会引发内生非平稳性，导致训练-测试-部署鸿沟；并呼吁以互依性为核心设计原则的"非唯我论"研究范式，涵盖动态评估、制度设计与人类主体性保护三个方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前AI研究的核心挑战正从"能力"转向"共存"。主流范式（预训练-后训练-基准刷分）隐含环境外生、分布平稳、单一智能体优化三大假设，忽视部署后其他行为者的策略性适应。作者认为这种"唯我论"路径在能力扩展到超级智能层面时仍将产生不合作的系统，因为部署本身就是对耦合系统的干预，会引发行为者、制度和算法三类适应性响应，可能将社会技术系统推向退化均衡。论文旨在揭示AI安全研究中对齐框架的结构性不足，呼吁从"个体对齐"转向"制度性对齐"。

Method: 论文采用概念分析与形式化建模相结合的方法：(1)将单智能体MDP形式化框架扩展为马尔可夫博弈，明确定义内生非平稳性（Definition A.1）、训练-测试-部署鸿沟（Definition A.2）、自我颠覆性（Definition A.3），并给出充分条件的形式化证明（Proposition A.4）；(2)引入均衡选择风险（ESR, Definition A.8）量化部署对均衡福利的影响；(3)通过行为适应（GPS依赖、拼写退化、翻译工具等）、制度适应（保险远程信息处理、平台内容审核、税务审计等）、算法适应（广告竞价、智能电网、加密货币交易机器人、LLM定价代理等）三类实证案例佐证理论命题；(4)对"多智能体设计失败模式更严重""竞争压力自然产生合作""实证记录不支持警觉""规模化能解决交互动力学""合作可作为能力训练""现有制度与合规足够"六种反对意见进行系统反驳。

Result: 论文得出三项核心论断与一项研究纲领：(1)关键论断1——在多AI多人类共存的世界中，合作是受益结果持续的**必要条件**，不是可选附加能力；(2)关键论断2——训练-测试-部署鸿沟源于人类、制度和算法的策略性适应所引起的结构化非平稳性，唯我论范式无法识别其结构；(3)关键论断3——预测无法替代参与：认识论限制（新颖性、反射性、组合爆炸）使预测新颖均衡不可行，且合法性约束使单边控制在开放社会中不可接受。研究纲领上提出三条路径：动态评估（评估分布由策略依赖的自适应对手方生成）、制度设计（将制度作为可共同学习的原始构件）、保留人类主体性（防止认知技能萎缩与代理权压缩）。作者认为这些都是结构性问题，无法通过单纯规模化解决。

Conclusion: 论文结论为：无论在平稳任务上多么强大，唯我论超级智能都不太可能具有合作性。在充斥其他自适应智能体的环境中进行单边优化本质上是自我颠覆的，因为部署引发了使训练假设失效的非平稳性。认识论限制排除了对新颖均衡的预测，合法性约束排除了单边控制（即使预测可能成功）。论文呼吁将部署视为对耦合系统的干预（而非对固定系统的插入），将共存而非能力作为有益AI的约束条件。AI研究范式需从"对静态任务的优化能力"转向"对动态多行为者均衡的参与能力"，在评估、治理与人类能动性三个层面进行系统性重构。

Abstract: AI's central challenge is shifting from capability to coexistence. The dominant paradigm in AI research focuses on developing powerful agents that treat the world as an exogenous and stationary source of feedback. We contend that superintelligence, an extremely capable task solver, born out of such a solipsistic approach to AI design, is unlikely to be cooperative. Deploying AI systems induces endogenous non-stationarity, resulting in a train-test-deploy gap where historical distributions diverge from the deployment context. We refer to this as the self-undermining property of unilateral optimization. Closing this gap requires AI that participates in cooperation: the equilibrium-selection process through which multiple actors navigate their interdependence. We call for a non-solipsistic research paradigm that treats this interdependence as a core design principle rather than approaching cooperation as a task to solve. This entails building dynamic evaluation testbeds involving adaptive counterparties, treating institutions as design primitives, and preserving human agency as a structural feature of the systems we build.

</details>


### [317] [Do Real-World Datasets Contain Natural Experiments? An Empirical Study Using Causal Feature Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03251)
*Gautam Gare,John Galeotti,Michael Mozer,Deva Ramanan,Nan Rosemary Ke*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于因果发现的方法来检测真实数据集中是否存在的"自然实验"（natural experiments），即数据中隐含的干预机制。研究表明，现实世界的数据集中确实存在自然实验，并通过因果推断方法可以提升下游模型性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在自然界和社会中，事件往往只影响部分个体或群体而对其他部分无影响，这种隐含的干预被称为"自然实验"（如COVID-19疫情只感染部分人群）。作者提出一个关键问题：现有真实世界数据集中是否存在自然实验？如果存在，我们应如何处理它们以提升模型性能？这一研究填补了因果推断与现实数据建模之间的空白。

Method: 1. **因果发现（Causal Discovery）**：利用因果发现算法从数据中恢复底层因果图（causal graph）。
2. **特征选择**：基于因果图中的因果链接进行特征选择，区分观测性特征与受干预影响的特征。
3. **干预性建模**：将数据作为干预性（interventional）而非纯观测性（observational）数据进行处理。
4. **验证流程**：
   - 在合成图生成的模拟数据集（有/无自然实验）上验证假设。
   - 在大规模真实世界数据集套件上进行系统性实证评估。
5. **评估指标**：通过下游任务（如预测）性能的提升来判断数据集中是否存在自然实验。

Result: 1. 在合成数据实验中，该方法能够有效区分含自然实验与不含自然实验的数据集。
2. 在大量真实世界数据集上的实证评估表明：真实数据集中确实存在自然实验。
3. 将数据视为干预性数据（而非纯观测性数据）进行处理，可以显著提升下游模型的性能。
4. 验证了基于因果发现的特征选择方法在检测和利用自然实验方面的有效性。

Conclusion: 真实世界数据集中普遍存在自然实验（隐含干预），传统的纯观测性建模方式未能充分利用这些信息。通过因果发现识别自然实验并采用因果推断方法处理数据，能够有效提升模型性能。本研究是自然实验检测领域的初步探索，为未来在更广泛场景中应用因果推断提供了新的方向，但研究范围仍存在一定局限性。

Abstract: In nature, events that affect some individuals or groups but not others constitute an implicit intervention and are known as natural experiments. For example, the COVID-19 pandemic was an intervention by the coronavirus on the sub-population infected with COVID. We ask, do natural experiments occur in existing real-world datasets? If yes, how should we treat them? To detect natural experiments in data, we use causal discovery to recover the underlying causal graph and perform feature selection based on causal links. If downstream performance improves by treating the data as interventional rather than observational, we argue that this suggests the dataset contains natural experiments. We first validate this hypothesis by simulating datasets with and without natural experiments using synthetic graphs. We then perform a systematic empirical evaluation on a large suite of real-world datasets. Our results indicate that real-world datasets do contain natural experiments and we can take advantage of those natural experiments to improve model performance using causal inference. Our work represents the initial foray into this area, offering a preliminary exploration within a limited scope.

</details>


### [318] [Distilling Answer-Set Programming Rules from LLMs for Neurosymbolic Visual Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03269)
*Thomas Eiter,Nelson Higuera Ruiz,Johannes Oetsch*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种从大型语言模型（LLMs）中蒸馏规则的方法，用于视觉问答（VQA）任务。该方法通过提示LLM扩展基于答案集程序（ASP）的初始VQA推理理论，以适应任务的新需求。实验表明，仅需少量示例即可从LLM中提取出正确的规则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模块化VQA方法虽然比端到端系统更具可解释性，但在任务需求变化时，扩展其逻辑表示对开发者而言负担沉重。传统的数据驱动规则学习方法存在局限性，因此需要一种更灵活的方法来自动获取和更新推理规则。

Method: 方法核心是从LLM中蒸馏规则：1) 以答案集程序（ASP）表达的初始VQA推理理论作为基础；2) 利用VQA数据集中的示例引导LLM扩展规则；3) 通过ASP求解器的反馈来验证和修正LLM生成的错误规则；4) 该方法支持在不同VQA数据集上应用。

Result: 实验结果表明：1) 该方法在多个不同的VQA数据集上均有效；2) 仅需少量示例即可从LLM中引出正确的规则；3) 基于LLM的规则蒸馏方法是传统数据驱动规则学习的一种有前景的替代方案。

Conclusion: 从LLM中蒸馏规则为VQA任务提供了一种有前景的替代方案，能够有效减轻开发者在扩展模块化推理系统时的负担。该方法结合了LLM的语言理解能力和符号推理的可解释性优势。论文已被Theory and Practice of Logic Programming (TPLP)期刊审稿中。

Abstract: Visual Question Answering (VQA) is the task of answering questions about images, requiring the integration of multimodal input and reasoning. Modular approaches that incorporate logic-based representations into the reasoning component offer clear advantages over end-to-end trained systems, particularly in terms of interpretability. However, adapting or extending these representations when task requirements change can place a significant burden on developers. To address this challenge, we present an approach for distilling rules from Large Language Models (LLMs). Our method prompts an LLM to extend an initial VQA reasoning theory, expressed as an answer-set program, to meet new requirements of the task. Examples from VQA datasets guide the LLM, validate the results, and help correct erroneous rules by leveraging feedback from the ASP solver. We demonstrate that our approach is effective across diverse VQA datasets. Notably, only a few examples are needed to elicit correct rules from LLMs. Our experiments suggest that rule distillation from LLMs is a promising alternative to traditional data-driven rule learning approaches. Under consideration in Theory and Practice of Logic Programming (TPLP).

</details>


### [319] [A Negative Result on Cross-Model Activation Transfer in a Pythia Multi-Hop Setting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03280)
*Peiyan Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究在Pythia-160M到Pythia-410M的多跳推理场景中测试了跨模型激活值传输机制。线性翻译层在归一化空间中能达到较高的表征对齐（余弦相似度≈0.97，R²≈0.88），但将翻译后的激活注入接收模型后并不能提升下游答题效果。替换式注入具有破坏性，即便修正L2范数也无法恢复性能。本质上是一个范围明确的负面结果：离线表征对齐不足以保证接收端的因果可用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期研究表明，模型可通过生成数据中的隐含信号传递行为特征。论文进一步追问：是否可以在推理时通过翻译和注入隐藏激活而非自然语言文本来传递更直接、更严格的中间推理状态？即探索"绕过文本瓶颈"实现模型间直接激活通信的可能性。

Method: 实验设置：发送端Pythia-160M，接收端Pythia-410M，均为GPT-NeoX架构。注入深度固定在相对深度0.67（发送端第8层，接收端第16层）。任务为多跳推理，包含396个样本。核心方法：(1) 训练线性翻译层在L2归一化空间中将发送端隐藏状态映射到接收端空间；(2) 在推理时采用多种注入协议——无注入、自然语言中继、加性注入（小比例向量加和）、替换式注入（完全替换接收端隐藏状态）、尺度修正后替换注入等；(3) 使用B-to-B自注入、同范数随机向量、置换翻译等控制实验。主要指标为词边界答案包含率。

Result: 翻译层质量较高：归一化余弦相似度≈0.9735，归一化R²≈0.8828。但下游表现均不理想：加性注入均值0.0926（vs无注入0.0884），但95%置信区间跨越零点（[-0.42%, +1.26%]），不构成稳定提升；替换式注入降至0.0025；尺度修正后替换仅升至0.0076，仍远低于基线；自然语言中继为0.0833，与无注入相当。失败原因分解为两个可量化因素：(1) 翻译向量范数（约0.85）与接收端原生隐藏状态范数（约68.70）存在约两个数量级的严重失配；(2) 即使通过尺度修正闭合范数差距后，残留的方向或分布错误仍造成约8.59个百分点的性能下降。控制实验确认：钩子机制本身无破坏性（B-to-B自注入与无注入完全一致），且单纯注入正确量级的随机向量同样具有破坏性。

Conclusion: 该研究得出范围明确的负面结论：离线表征对齐与接收端因果可用性是可分离的两个属性。高归一化空间相似度并不保证翻译后的激活能被接收模型在其计算中有效使用。这并非否定模型间隐藏信息传输的存在（如同学习中的数据介导通道所证明的），而是为激活通信研究划定了边界——有用的模型间激活通信可能需要优化接收端因果使用能力的训练目标，而非仅优化发送-接收表征拟合。该结果不构成关于隐通道通信、激活引导或模型拼接的一般性不可能性声明，仅适用于所测试的特定协议。

Abstract: Recent work shows that language models can transmit behavioural traits through hidden signals in generated data during training. We ask whether a more direct and stricter channel is also viable: can one language model communicate useful intermediate reasoning state to another at inference time by translating and injecting hidden activations, rather than by passing natural-language text? We test this question in a controlled Pythia-160M to Pythia-410M multi-hop reasoning setting. A linear translation layer learns a strong normalized-space map between sender and receiver hidden states, with normalized cosine similarity near 0.97 across seeds. However, when the translated activations are injected into the receiver at inference time, they do not improve downstream answering. Low-strength additive injection remains near the no-injection baseline, with confidence intervals that cross zero. Replacement-style injection is consistently destructive, and rescaling translated vectors to the receiver hidden-state norm does not rescue performance. The result is therefore a scoped negative result: in this setting, offline representational alignment is not sufficient for useful causal communication inside the receiver.

</details>


### [320] [LEAP: Supercharging LLMs for Formal Mathematics with Agentic Frameworks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03303)
*Po-Nien Kung,Linfeng Song,Dawsen Hwang,Jinsung Yoon,Chun-Liang Li,Simone Severini,Mirek Olšák,Edward Lockhart,Quoc V Le,Burak Gokturk,Thang Luong,Tomas Pfister,Nanyun Peng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: LEAP是一个智能体框架，使通用大语言模型（无需针对形式化数学微调）在Lean形式化定理证明中达到最先进水平。核心思想是借鉴人类数学家的工作流——先构建高层非形式化蓝图（blueprint），再通过AND-OR DAG（与或图）分层分解目标，由Lean编译器提供迭代反馈。论文还提出了Lean-IMO-Bench基准，涵盖60道IMO风格问题。在Putnam 2025竞赛中LEAP解决全部12题，在Lean-IMO-Bench上将通用LLM的一次性通过率从不到10%提升到70%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前大语言模型在非形式化数学推理上表现强劲，但在生成可机械验证的形式化证明（Lean等）方面能力薄弱。主流方法依赖在形式化语料上微调专用证明模型（如AlphaProof、DeepSeek Prover V2等），假设通用LLM无法胜任严格形式化任务。论文质疑这一假设：通用LLM的瓶颈不在于语言理解，而在于缺乏与证明环境进行结构化、迭代式交互的能力。同时，现有基准（如MiniF2F、PutnamBench）已趋于饱和，需要更具挑战性的评估手段。

Method: LEAP框架包含三大核心设计：1) **基于DAG的分层记忆化**——将证明目标组织为AND-OR有向无环图，OR节点代表待证目标/引理，AND节点代表分解方案。支持单调精化和引理记忆化（含前瞻性引理规划）。2) **交错式非形式化-形式化规划**——先生成非形式化证明或蓝图，再翻译为Lean代码。3) **验证引导的证明搜索**——利用Lean编译器做语法/类型检查，利用LLM评审器判断分解是否真正简化了问题。系统首先尝试直接证明（含编译器反馈修订和LeanSearch检索），失败后转入分解路径。工作流以深度优先搜索配合回溯执行。

Result: 1) **Putnam 2025**：LEAP解决全部12题（100%），而Gemini-3.1-pro和Goedel-Prover-V2-32B一次性证明0题，Hilbert解决4题（33.3%），Aristotle解决9题（75%）。2) **Lean-IMO-Bench**：LEAP在Basic集上达到83.3%，在Advanced集上达到56.7%，在代数和数论类别中达100%通过率；几何类因缺乏领域专用框架仍是难点。3) **消融实验**：DAG记忆化相比朴素树结构在Basic集提升10%、Advanced集提升16.7%；LLM评审器对Putnam A5题至关重要（无评审器则8次rollout仍失败）。4) **研究级应用**：自动形式化了Knuth关于偶数阶Cayley图Hamilton分解的关键子问题（生成超5000行Lean 4代码），以及Erdős问题457的证明。

Conclusion: LEAP证明了通用大语言模型在合适的智能体框架支撑下，无需形式化微调即可在自动定理证明中达到甚至超越专用模型。这一发现挑战了"专业化微调不可或缺"的固有认知，将形式化数学的瓶颈从模型能力转移到搜索效率和分解策略上。未来工作需关注分解粒度、搜索空间分支优先级及计算分配等问题，混合架构（通用模型做高层规划+专用模型做局部步骤生成）是值得探索的方向。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit strong informal mathematical reasoning but struggle to generate mechanically verifiable proofs in formal languages like Lean. We present LEAP, an agentic framework that enables general-purpose foundation models to achieve state-of-the-art performance on automated formal theorem proving. LEAP leverages foundation model capabilities, such as informal reasoning, instruction following, and iterative self-refinement. By decomposing complex problems into smaller units, the system bridges formal proof construction with informal blueprints through continuous interaction with the Lean compiler. To provide a rigorous evaluation beyond increasingly saturated benchmarks, we introduce Lean-IMO-Bench, a benchmark of IMO-style problems formalized in Lean, with short statements yet highly non-routine and multi-step proofs across a wide range of difficulty levels. Empirically, on the latest 2025 Putnam Competition, an annual mathematics competition for undergraduate students in North America, LEAP solves all 12 problems, matching recent breakthroughs by frontier formal mathematical models. On Lean-IMO-Bench, LEAP boosts the one-shot formal solve rate of general-purpose LLMs from below 10% to 70%, notably surpassing the 48% benchmark set by a specialized, gold-medal-caliber IMO system. Furthermore, we demonstrate LEAP's research-level utility by autonomously formalizing complex proofs for open combinatorial challenges, including a verified proof for a key subproblem in Knuth's Hamiltonian decomposition of even-order Cayley graphs.

</details>


### [321] [The Reliability Gap in Benchmark Auditing: Distribution Shift and Scale as Failure Modes of Contamination Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03305)
*Wojciech Zarzecki,Jan Dubiński,Sebastian Cygert*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文系统评估了三种主流基准污染检测方法（LLM Dataset Inference、Post-Hoc Dataset Inference、CoDeC）在真实基准审计场景中的可靠性，识别出分布偏移和规模约束两大失效模式。在335次评估中仅199次得出正确结果（约60%），揭示了受控学术验证与实际基准审计之间存在系统性可靠性差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准污染检测方法几乎仅在受控学术环境（大规模同质预训练语料、透明的单一阶段训练管道）下验证。当应用于现实审计场景时，怀疑集与验证集的IID假设常被违反（分布偏移），且基准数据规模远小于预训练语料（规模约束），导致这些方法的有效性存疑。本文旨在系统检验这些方法在"in-the-wild"指令调优模型上的可靠性。

Method: 评估了三种检测范式：(1) LLM Dataset Inference——聚合弱成员推理信号并对怀疑集与未见验证集做单侧t检验；(2) Post-Hoc Dataset Inference——用小型生成器合成验证数据，通过文本分类器与文本+MIA组合分类器的AUC差异做校准检验；(3) CoDeC——通过同数据集上下文示例降低模型置信度的样本比例来度量污染。实验覆盖27个模型（Pythia、OLMo 2、PLLuM波兰语模型、医疗领域LLM如MedGemma/Meditron3/Meerkat/Neeto-1.0，以及Gemma 3、Qwen 3、Llama 3.2等工业前沿模型），规模最高达27B参数，共335次评估。设置四个任务：基准规模审计、分割级审计、专业后训练数据集审计、工业模型比较审计。

Result: 主要发现：(1) LLM DI在分布偏移下产生大量假阳性（如OLMo 2的DROP和MMLU误报），因分割间难度/风格差异被误判为训练暴露；(2) Post-Hoc DI在基准规模下因合成验证数据质量差而失效（文本分类器Base AUC >0.78，分布偏移主导信号），仅在完整Pile子集全规模下恢复性能；(3) CoDeC对同一数据集的train/test分割给出几乎相同的污染分数，只能提供粗粒度的数据来源信号，无法做分割级认证；(4) 在医疗QA、波兰语PLLuM等专业领域检测性能进一步退化；(5) 工业模型中Gemma 3系列在GSM8K上CoDeC分数持续偏低且未被LLM DI标记，暗示其未在GSM8K训练集上训练。综合而言统计检测尚不能替代透明的数据来源记录。

Conclusion: 当前基准污染检测方法在"in-the-wild"指令调优模型上的可靠性存在系统性差距：IID假设是LLM DI的关键脆弱性；基准规模数据对Post-Hoc DI的生成式方法而言过小；CoDeC的检测粒度仅支持粗粒度来源排序而非单个基准的完整性认证。结论是不存在解决实际污染检测的"银弹"，统计审计不能取代透明的数据来源；LLM DI仅在有真正未见且近似IID验证集时可用，Post-Hoc DI需能独立评估合成保持数据质量，CoDeC应仅作为比较性污染指标。论文开源了基准和代码以供后续研究。

Abstract: Benchmark contamination, where evaluation examples appear in a model's training data, threatens the validity of LLM assessment. Statistical tools for detecting training-data membership exist, but have been validated almost exclusively in controlled academic regimes: large, homogeneous pre-training corpora and transparent, single-stage training pipelines. Whether these methods remain reliable in realistic auditing scenarios remains unclear. We identify two under-studied failure modes: distribution shift, which arises when suspect and validation sets violate the IID assumption, and scale constraints, which arise because benchmarks are orders of magnitude smaller than pre-training corpora. We systematically evaluate three leading paradigms: LLM Dataset Inference, Post-Hoc Dataset Inference, and CoDeC across 27 models from multiple families (including Pythia, OLMo~2, and specialised cultural and medical LLMs) and scales (up to 27B). We then further extend our analysis to frontier industry models. Across 335 evaluations, only 199 yield correct outcomes. LLM Dataset Inference results in false positives under distribution shift, Post-Hoc Dataset Inference is underpowered at benchmark scale, and CoDeC provides only coarse provenance signals that are insufficient to verify individual benchmark splits. Our results reveal a systematic reliability gap between controlled validation and practical benchmark auditing, and show that statistical detection cannot yet replace transparent data provenance. We open-source our benchmark for further research.

</details>


### [322] [The Violation Situation Pattern: A Knowledge-Graph Pattern for Compliance Violations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03326)
*Nima Kamali Lassem,Fuqi Song,Seyid Amjad Ali*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出违规情境模式（Violation Situation Pattern, VSP），将合规违规检测结果物化为知识图谱中的持久节点（具有规则标识、时态有效性区间、生命周期状态与证据链接），并通过不可变、PROV-O对齐的LifecycleTransition事件记录审计历史；通过在法律实体与合同生命周期属性图上实例化四条义务规则（V1越权签字、V2过期授权、V3缺失保密条款、V4缺失违规通知条款），证明模式的"规则体独立性"——扩展V4规则体使F1从0.312提升至0.602而模式语义保持不变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有合规管道仅将违规作为瞬态查询结果返回，未将违规本身作为持久化图对象保留，导致重复检测产生重复记录、审查状态散落在工单系统中、审计历史无法通过图遍历重建；现有的本体设计模式（Situation、PROV-O、TimeIndexedSituation等）均未同时满足稳定身份、有限状态生命周期、不可变转换日志与多指代证据这四项合规审计要求。

Method: 1）形式化定义VSP为四元组(r, T, S, E)——规则标识、时态有效性区间、五态生命周期（DETECTED/CONFIRMED/UNDER_REVIEW/REMEDIATED/DISMISSED）、证据边集；2）在属性图上通过复合主键(violationType, contract_id, person_id)实现MERGE的幂等身份合并；3）通过FCL→Cypher→MERGE三层管道实例化四条义务规则；4）使用BODACC公报数据验证V1/V2、GDPRhub 73条执法决定评估V4、SHACL跨形式化检查V3/V4，并在GDPR同意模式上做模式迁移健全性检验。

Result: V1/V2在BODACC公报一致性检查中能无错误分离全部177个CLEAN与177个过期授权案例及40个V1-proxy和20个对抗性样本；V4在GDPRhub 73条决定上，规则A（仅检查条款存在）F1=0.312，规则B（增加72小时截止检查）F1=0.602，ΔF1=+0.290，精度在两种规则下均为1.000；SHACL跨形式化检查显示V4在两种形式化下完全对齐（10/10重叠），V3因范围约定不同存在预期差异；GDPR同意模式迁移检验中VSP结构不变，规则体和证据边词汇按域调整即可。

Conclusion: VSP通过将违规物化为带复合身份、五态生命周期、不可变转换日志与多指代证据边的持久图节点，同时满足合规审计的四项核心属性；规则体独立性的实证证据（V4扩展使F1提升0.290而模式语义不变）将"模式贡献"与"检测器贡献"解耦，使检测逻辑可演进而不破坏已积累的审计历史；其能力虽然可通过SHACL+SPARQL+PROV-O组合附加自定义词汇和编排来达到，但VSP将其内化为单一图模式。

Abstract: Compliance pipelines detect violations as transient query results and do not keep the violation itself as a persistent graph object with review state, affected entities, or audit history. The Violation Situation Pattern (VSP) closes this gap. Building on the Situation pattern of Gangemi and Mika, VSP reifies each detected violation as a graph node with a rule identifier, a temporal validity interval, a lifecycle state, and evidence links to the entities involved. Lifecycle transitions are stored as immutable, PROV-O-aligned events, so audit history is a graph traversal. We instantiate VSP in a legal entity and contract lifecycle property graph and operationalize four deontic rules (V1 unauthorized signature, V2 expired mandate, V3 missing confidentiality clause, V4 missing breach-notification clause) through an FCL->Cypher->MERGE pipeline. We check V1 and V2 against BODACC corporate-officer publications, evaluate V4 on 73 GDPRhub enforcement decisions, and run a SHACL cross-formalism check on V3 and V4. The central finding is rule-body independence: extending V4 from clause-presence to deadline checking raises F1 from 0.312 to 0.602, while the pattern's identity, lifecycle, and evidence semantics stay the same. This separates a pattern contribution from a detector contribution, so detection logic can evolve without invalidating accumulated audit history.

</details>


### [323] [InfoMem: Training Long-Context Memory Agents with Answer-Conditioned Information Gain](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03329)
*Tiancheng Han,Yong Li,Wuzhou Yu,Qiaosheng Zhang,Wenqi Shao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: InfoMem 是一种针对分块式长上下文记忆智能体的强化学习奖励机制，通过衡量最终记忆对ground-truth答案的逐token对数似然的提升程度（answer-conditioned information gain）来直接监督记忆质量，仅在成功轨迹上施加该信号并在奖励组合前进行归一化，从而在 GRPO 框架下稳定提升长上下文问答性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于强化学习的分块式长上下文记忆智能体主要依赖稀疏的最终答案奖励或基于词法重叠的中间奖励（如 ReMemR1）。这些信号无法直接区分成功轨迹中最终记忆的语义支撑能力——不同记忆可能都得出正确答案，但有的聚焦关键证据，有的包含大量冗余或干扰信息。此外，分布级的互信息 I(M;Y|X) 在 LLM 高维语义空间中难以可靠估计，亟需一种可操作的、针对最终记忆质量的奖励信号。

Method: InfoMem 核心奖励 r_gain 定义为在带记忆条件和无记忆条件下，ground-truth 答案逐token平均对数似然之差，采用 teacher forcing 计算。关键设计包括：(1) 成功轨迹监督——仅对 R_outcome=1 的轨迹施加 r_gain，避免在错误答案上引入噪声信号；(2) 预归一化——在奖励组合前对同一 rollout 组内成功轨迹的 r_gain 做 z-score 标准化，控制不同 prompt 间的奖励尺度差异；(3) 与稀疏 outcome 奖励线性组合 R_i = R_outcome,i + β·r̃_i，最终通过 GRPO 进行策略优化。该奖励在 trajectory 级别计算，优势传播到所有生成 token。

Result: 在 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 基础模型上，使用 RULER-HotpotQA 训练集（512 样本下采样）、GRPO 算法、120 步训练：(1) 合成幻觉证据诊断显示 r_gain 的 MRR 达 0.977、Z-score SNR 达 2.960，显著优于嵌入相似度（BGE-M3、E5、Qwen3-Embedding）和注意力分数（Attn-Mass、Attn-Top1）；(2) 在 CorpusQA、LongMemEval、MRCR-8needle、RULER synthetic QA 四个 OOD 长上下文基准上均取得最佳综合性能，优于 Outcome-only GRPO 和 ReMemR1；(3) 消融实验验证了三个关键设计选择：成功侧监督、组合前归一化、答案条件（而非查询条件）。QueryPMI 变体表现较差，且会导致模型通过复制查询来"作弊"，query 重复率显著上升。

Conclusion: InfoMem 验证了答案条件信息增益作为最终记忆直接监督信号的有效性，识别出有效最终记忆奖励应具备的三个特性：对成功轨迹进行正例式监督、奖励组合前归一化、以 ground-truth 答案而非查询为条件。这为分块式长上下文 RL 提供了一种更原则化、更稳定的记忆塑造框架。局限性在于实验规模较小（1.5B 模型、512 训练样本）、仅适用于分块式记忆智能体范式、奖励仅定义于最终步骤未覆盖中间过程监督。

Abstract: Long-context tasks require LLMs to identify and preserve answer-relevant information from large contexts. Chunk-wise memory agents address this issue by sequentially reading document chunks, updating a compact memory, and generating the final answer from the accumulated memory. However, existing RL-based chunk-wise agents either rely on sparse final-answer rewards or use lexical intermediate rewards for memory and retrieval actions. These signals supervise task success or local overlap, but do not directly evaluate whether the final memory supports the ground-truth answer. We propose InfoMem, a reward mechanism for training chunk-wise memory agents that evaluates final-memory utility using answer-conditioned information. InfoMem measures how much the final memory increases the model's per-token log-likelihood of the ground-truth answer. To stabilize RL optimization, InfoMem applies this signal only to successful trajectories and normalizes it before reward composition. Under the same GRPO framework and training budget, InfoMem improves long-context memory-agent performance over comparable memory-agent RL baselines. Analyses show that effective final-memory rewards should operate on successful trajectories, be normalized before reward composition, and be conditioned on the answer rather than the query. Our code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [324] [CP-Agent: Context-Aware Multimodal Reasoning for Cellular Morphological Profiling under Chemical Perturbations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03435)
*Yuxin Zhang,Yiyao Li,Ping Shu Ho,Simon See,Zhenqin Wu,Kevin Tsia*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出CP-Agent，一种面向Cell Painting药物筛选的上下文感知多模态推理框架。其核心是CP-CLIP对比学习模块，通过定制的占位符Token注入策略将高内涵图像与结构化实验元数据（化合物、浓度、时间）联合嵌入。CP-Agent在1.9百万图像-上下文对上预训练，由六个协作子智能体（CPContext、ChannelSeg、CellFeat、FeatRank、StatSynth、ReportGen）组成，可在Cell Painting扰动分析中生成机制可解释的报告。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Cell Painting药物筛选流程面临三大挑战：（1）形态学响应高度依赖实验上下文（细胞系、剂量、时间），现有方法通常通过晚融合或非结构化文本附加元数据，忽视了这一重要信号；（2）不同机制的化合物可能产生收敛的形态学表型，降低MoA（作用机制）分辨率；（3）图像嵌入作为非结构化特征向量缺乏语义基础，限制了下游生物推理能力。通用MLLM（Grok-4、GPT-5、Claude-4-Sonnet、Gemini-2.5-Pro）在Cell Painting任务上表现不佳，化合物分类F1分数普遍低于随机基线，表明需要生物学先验监督。

Method: 方法包含两大核心模块：（1）**CP-CLIP感知层**：采用对比学习框架联合嵌入高内涵图像与结构化实验元数据；引入`<CMPD>`、`<CONC>`、`<TIME>`三种占位符Token，通过字段特定的MLP将化合物描述符（174维RDKit2D）、归一化浓度对$[ρ_{max}, s(C)]$、归一化时间$\tilde{t}$动态映射为D维嵌入，与子词嵌入混合输入文本Transformer；图像端采用扰动-对照双Tile拼接（$512\times512\times2$），经CLAHE等预处理；训练采用InfoNCE或SigLIP损失，基于1.9M图像-上下文对（BBBC021/CPJUMP1/RxRx3）预训练。（2）**CP-Agent智能体层**：包含六个协作模块——CPContext（上下文检索与标准化）、ChannelSeg（基于微调VISTA-2D的实例分割，IoU从0.272提升至0.824）、CellFeat（CellProfiler特征提取）、FeatRank（机制感知特征排序）、StatSynth（Cliff's delta、bootstrap CI、Mann-Whitney U检验等统计证据合成）、ReportGen（最终报告生成）。

Result: 主要实验结果包括：（1）**已知药物分类**：CP-CLIP ViT-B/16（descriptor）宏平均F1达0.896，显著优于所有通用MLLM（最高Gemini-2.5-Pro仅0.007）和CLIP/SigLIP基线；细胞系/通道任务F1均达1.000。（2）**未见药物零样本匹配**：平均相似度0.444（ViT-L/16），较CLIP基线（0.286）提升14.6%，显示强泛化能力。（3）**嵌入结构**：UMAP可视化显示按MoA和剂量梯度的清晰聚类，Anisomycin和Bryostatin等呈现锐利的剂量-响应轨迹。（4）**专家评估**：11位专家对4个LLM生成的40份报告进行10维度评分，GPT-5与Gemini-2.5-Pro在推理质量上表现最佳，Kendall's W为0.33-0.37。（5）**消融实验**：反事实提示下CP-CLIP浓度分类F1较CLIP提升50.55%，时间分类提升35.23%，证实其学习的是鲁棒多模态关联而非元数据快捷方式。

Conclusion: CP-Agent建立了一种将MLLM与机制基础分析相结合的新范式，通过"感知-检索-分析-报告"的多智能体架构将高维形态学特征转化为紧凑、可追溯的生物学叙述。其模块化设计支持QPI、全息显微、亮场时序成像等多种模态，并可灵活集成ilastik、Fiji、Icy等工具。局限性在于依赖结构化实验元数据，且MLLM推理的最终报告仍需领域专家校验。未来方向包括实验规划（剂量策略优化）、多组学融合以及反事实因果推理的扩展，有望为下一代表型药物发现AI系统奠定基础。

Abstract: Cell Painting combines multiplexed fluorescent staining, high-content imaging, and quantitative analysis to generate high-dimensional phenotypic readouts to support diverse downstream tasks such as mechanism-of-action (MoA) inference, toxicity prediction, and construction of drug-disease atlases. However, existing workflows are slow, costly and difficult to interpret. Approaches for drug screening modeling predominantly focus on molecular representation learning, while neglecting actual experimental context (e.g., cell line, dosing schedule, etc.), limiting generalization and MoA resolution. We introduce CP-Agent, an agentic multimodal large language model (MLLM) capable of generating mechanism-relevant, human-interpretable rationales for cell morphological changes under drug perturbations. At its core, CP-Agent leverages a context-aware alignment module, CP-CLIP, that jointly embeds high-content images and experimental metadata to enable robust treatment and MoA discrimination (achieving a maximum F1-score of 0.896). By integrating CP-CLIP outputs with agentic tool usage and reasoning, CP-Agent compiles rationales into a structured report to guide experimental design and hypothesis refinement. These capabilities highlight CP-Agent's potential to accelerate drug discovery by enabling more interpretable, scalable, and context-aware phenotypic screening -- streamlining iterative cycles of hypothesis generation in drug discovery.

</details>


### [325] [What Makes Interaction Trajectories Effective for Training Terminal Agents?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03461)
*Sidi Yang,Chaofan Tao,Jierun Chen,Tiezheng Yu,Ruoyu Wang,Yuxin Jiang,Yiming Du,Wendong Xu,Jing Xiong,Taiqiang Wu,Lifeng Shang,Xiaohui Li,Ngai Wong,Haoli Bai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文挑战了"教师模型越强、学生模型越好"的传统蒸馏假设，揭示了终端智能体后训练中的"教学悖论"：独立任务表现更强的教师（如 Claude Opus 4.6）反而不如表现较弱的教师（如 DeepSeek-V3.2）能培养出更优秀的学生。研究提出"环境锚定监督"（EGS）框架，并设计"目标观察比率"（TOR）作为轨迹质量的预测指标，仅用 15.3k 数据即让 Qwen3-32B 在 Terminal-Bench 2.0 上达到与 30× 数据量相当的 SOTA 性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体后训练普遍遵循"强者为师"的假设——认为基准测试得分更高的教师模型必然能蒸馏出更好的学生模型。然而这一假设未与任务难度、harness 设计和学生能力等因素解耦，存在根本性的混淆。本文旨在系统性地探究代码智能体领域中"解题能力"与"教学能力"是否真正等同，并通过受控实验揭示轨迹质量的关键决定因素。

Method: 1. 构建 Terminal-Lego 数据流水线：从 StackOverflow 90+ 领域真实问题出发，经级联 LLM 生成（指令→环境→方案→Dockerfile→测试）、LLM 审阅反馈循环、Docker 往返验证，产出可执行、可自动评测的智能体终端任务。
2. 匹配任务蒸馏设置：固定 Terminus-2 harness、固定学生骨架（Qwen3-8B/32B）、固定训练配方与评测基准（Terminal-Bench 2.0），仅在四个教师模型（Claude Opus 4.6、Qwen3.5-Plus、GLM-5、DeepSeek-V3.2）间比较轨迹可教性。
3. 提出环境锚定监督（EGS）框架，定义目标观察比率（TOR）：衡量动作命令在路径层面是否得到先前观察命令支撑，量化教师"inspect-act-verify"循环的显性程度。
4. 多角度消融验证：轨迹长度对比、错误恢复对比、无错误过滤、失败轨迹训练、观察命令损失级遮蔽、目标/非目标观察遮蔽、高/低 TOR 子集对照。

Result: 1. 教学悖论实证：在 8.1k 共同任务集上，Claude Opus 4.6（独立得分 69.4）训练的 Qwen3-32B 仅 15.5%，而 DeepSeek-V3.2（独立得分 39.3）训练的 Qwen3-32B 达 20.6%；在 8B 规模上同样成立（5.6% vs 10.5%）。
2. 排除简单解释：更长轨迹与更多错误恢复并未提升教学效果；过滤错误消息后 DeepSeek 仍最优，且其性能下降最小（1.5% vs 其他教师 >5%）。
3. EGS 机制验证：遮蔽观察命令的损失级干预使 8B/32B 学生分别下降 6.7/6.8 个百分点；高 TOR 子集优于低 TOR 及随机基线；2.5k 失败 DeepSeek 轨迹仍能训练出优于 8.1k 通过的 Claude 轨迹的 32B 学生。
4. 数据效率突破：仅 15.3k Terminal-Lego 轨迹使 Qwen3-32B 在 TB 2.0 达到 24.3%（7× 基础性能提升），与超 30× 数据量的先前 SOTA 相当。
5. 行为模式分析：DeepSeek 轨迹呈现 71.8% 指令轮含观察命令，48% 为混合轮，95.8% 以观察开局，体现"先观察后行动"和"执行后验证"的核心工作流。

Conclusion: 代码智能体的解题能力与教学能力是相互独立（甚至正交）的维度。真正决定轨迹可教性的核心机制是"环境锚定监督"（EGS）——即教师是否通过 harness 可见的交互显式暴露"检查-行动-验证"循环；目标观察比率（TOR）可作为训练前数据效用的预测信号。研究将智能体后训练的研究焦点从"结果匹配"和"教师规模"转向"harness 工程"，主张通过系统设计环境锚定的交互结构来催化可复现、可泛化的智能体智能。

Abstract: Stronger code agents are commonly assumed to be superior teachers for post-training, yet this assumption remains poorly disentangled from task difficulty, harness design, and student capacity. We investigate this pedagogical link using Terminal-Lego, a scalable pipeline that transforms multi-domain real-world issues into environment-verified agentic tasks. Surprisingly, standalone performance does not dictate teaching efficacy: while Claude Opus 4.6 achieves higher scores on Terminal-Bench 2.0, students fine-tuned on trajectories from DeepSeek-V3.2, a lower-scoring agent, exhibit significantly stronger generalization. We attribute this "pedagogical paradox" to Environment-Grounded Supervision (EGS): trajectories that explicitly expose inspect-act-verify behaviors through harness-visible interactions allow students to internalize robust problem-solving routines rather than fragile action sequences. Scaling analysis reveals exceptional data efficiency: with only 15.3k Terminal-Lego trajectories, for example, Qwen3-32B achieves a 24.3% score on Terminal-Bench 2.0, rivaling previous SOTA performance established with over 30x the data volume. Our results suggest that the frontier of agent post-training lies beyond mere outcome-matching, shifting the focus toward "Harness Engineering", where the systematic design of environment-grounded interaction structures serves as the primary catalyst for reproducible and generalizable agentic intelligence.

</details>


### [326] [DMF: A Deterministic Memory Framework for Conversational AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03463)
*Matteo Stabile,Enrico Zimuel*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: DMF（确定性记忆框架）是一种用于对话AI智能体的CPU优先记忆管理系统，通过经典NLP分析、向量几何和数学评分完全替代LLM驱动的记忆压缩，实现确定性、可审计且几乎零token成本的记忆管理。在LoCoMo和LongMemEval基准测试中，DMF以零内存管理token开销达到了与Mem0相当或更优的准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM驱动的对话记忆压缩方法存在非确定性、token成本高、语义漂移和决策不透明等根本缺陷。DMF旨在通过完全确定性的数学管线消除LLM在记忆管理循环中的作用，从而实现可复现、低成本、可审计的对话记忆系统。

Method: DMF采用八层架构：(1) NLP特征提取——基于spaCy和VADER提取信息密度(ID)、情感幅度(|S|)、命名实体数(E)和语义散度(D)四个标量信号；(2) 评分引擎——通过内容、运营和出处三通道线性聚合后经logistic投影得到生存分数Ω；(3) 时间衰减模型——采用交互计数(Δn)而非挂钟时间作为衰减轴，并引入分数依赖惯性μ(Ω)=1-ηΩ，实现Ω_eff(Δn)=Ω·exp(-λ(1-ηΩ)Δn)；(4) 双轨剪枝机制——周期性硬淘汰(Ω_eff<Ω_kill)和预算压力剪枝(结合保留奖励和主题取代惩罚)；(5) 长期记忆归档——以原始RawLTMRecord为权威源，辅以确定性MemoryCard投影；(6) 结构化检索管线——四通道候选生成+可答性重排序+证据组装；(7) 社交地板启发式——保护短社交性回复免被过早剪枝。

Result: 在LoCoMo基准(1540题)上，DMF整体准确率0.7753(优于Mem0的0.6883，+12%)，时序推理组0.7072 vs Mem0的0.1526(4倍提升)，整体token消耗降低5倍，内存管理token为零。在LongMemEval-10(60题)上DMF准确率0.717 vs Mem0的0.767(-7%)，单会话助手组DMF以0.900 vs 0.600领先50%，总token消耗降低约242倍。系统确认零LLM调用即可在记忆管理循环中达到与LLM驱动方法相当或更优的准确率。

Conclusion: DMF证明了在对话AI记忆管理中可以完全消除LLM调用，同时保持相当的准确率并将token成本降至接近零。其核心科学贡献是确定性的可复现记忆状态（记忆是消息序列的确定性函数），核心实践贡献是数量级级别的token效率提升。未来工作包括多语言支持、自适应评分校准、图增强谱系、嵌入模型消融、动态token预算、确定性Q&A缓存和多智能体共享记忆。

Abstract: Conversational AI agents require memory systems that are both scalable and semantically coherent across long interaction horizons. Existing approaches rely predominantly on large language model (LLM)-based summarisation at write time, which introduces non-determinism, escalating token costs, and opacity in pruning decisions. We present the Deterministic Memory Framework (DMF), a CPU-first approach that replaces generative memory compression with a fully deterministic pipeline grounded in classical NLP analysis, vector geometry, and mathematical scoring. DMF assigns each conversational interaction a Survival Score $\Omega$ computed from deterministic content signals, conversational cues, and structured provenance, combined through a logistic projection. An interaction-count decay law, denoted as $\Omega_{\mathrm{eff}}(\Delta n)$, governs how relevance evolves as new turns arrive, where $\Delta n$ is the number of newer interactions rather than wall-clock time, preserving full determinism. We present the mathematical formulation of DMF, its structured recall pipeline, the pruning decision procedure, and the evaluation protocol. Experiments are conducted on a purpose-built benchmark using the LoCoMo and LongMemEval datasets. We compare DMF against Mem0, a popular memory layer for AI agents. DMF achieves comparable accuracy while using zero tokens to prepare the memory context and 5x to 242x fewer tokens over the entire conversation. These results show that it is possible to eliminate LLM calls from the memory-management loop, reducing token costs to nearly zero and enabling deterministic memory systems for conversational AI agents.

</details>


### [327] [StepFinder: A Temporal Semantic Framework for Failure Attribution in Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03467)
*Taiyu Zhu,Yifan Wu,Weilin Jin,Ying Li,Gang Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: StepFinder 是一种轻量级的多智能体系统（MAS）步骤级故障归因框架。它仅在特征编码阶段使用 LLM（Qwen3 Embedding）将执行轨迹编码为时序语义序列，然后通过 BiLSTM + Agent-Aware 注意力机制建模时序依赖与跨步交互，最后结合多尺度差分和位置偏置为每步计算异常分数以定位根因步骤。在 Who&When 基准上，其精度优于所有 LLM 推理方法和通用序列模型（BiGRU/TCN/Transformer），且推理时间比最快 LLM 方法减少 79%，无文本生成开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 多智能体系统在多步协作任务中失败率高达 41%–86.7%，且单步错误易通过交互级联放大。现有故障归因方法主要依赖 LLM 直接对原始执行轨迹进行推理，存在三大问题：① 推理成本高、延迟大；② 原始日志冗余且含噪，干扰 LLM 准确定位；③ 在长轨迹、复杂多智能体场景下步级定位精度不足。论文旨在将故障归因重新建模为结构化时序问题，用轻量深度学习替代 LLM 推理，以兼顾精度与效率。

Method: StepFinder 包含三大组件：  
(1) **轨迹编码**：使用 Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B 分别编码每步的“执行内容”和“智能体身份”为密集向量，形成时序语义序列。  
(2) **模型架构**：① 临时特征提取模块（TFE）——LayerNorm + 双向 LSTM（BiLSTM）+ LayerNorm 捕捉双向因果依赖；② 智能体感知步级交互模块（ASI）——在标准多头注意力中引入基于智能体身份余弦相似度的 agent-aware bias，并将全局智能体均值经 sigmoid 门控调制特征；③ 步级错误评分——非线性投影得到初步分数，叠加多尺度差分（多阶时间差分捕捉局部/累积异常）与线性衰减的位置偏置（偏向早期步骤），得到最终异常分数。  
(3) **损失函数**：监督交叉熵损失 + 自监督时间一致性损失（预测下一步隐藏状态以强化时序规律）。推理时仅用分类分支，直接取分数最高步作为根因。

Result: 在 Who&When 基准（Alg 126 条 / HC 58 条测试轨迹）上：  
- **精度（Acc@1）**：StepFinder 在 Alg 上达 29.63%，HC 上达 22.99%，分别超过最强基线 4.76% 和 10.35%（论文中 HC 提升以 BiGRU 为对照）；在 Alg 上较最强 LLM 方法（Step-by-Step ℊ）提升 9.52%，HC 提升超 200%。  
- **容差精度（±δ 步）**：Alg 集 δ=1 时领先最佳 LLM 方法约 15%，预测高度集中于真实根因附近。  
- **排序质量**：Alg 上 Acc@3=60.31%、MRR@3≈50%，均显著优于 LLM 和其他序列基线；HC 上 Acc@1 已超过多数基线的 Acc@3。  
- **消融实验**：BiLSTM 优于 LSTM/BiGRU/Transformer 作为 TFE 编码器；移除 TFE、ASI、智能体身份、多尺度差分、位置偏置或时间一致性损失均导致性能下降，验证各模块必要性。  
- **效率**：Alg 集每样本推理仅 0.61 s（最快 LLM 方法为 2.92 s，提速约 4.8×），HC 集 3.56 s；输入 token 与 All-at-Once 相当，输出 token 为 0（无文本生成），总体推理时间比最快 LLM 方法减少 79%。  
- **与同期工作对比**：AgenTracer（37.30%/20.68%）和 CDC-MAS（36.20%/18.20%）在 Alg 集更优（短结构化轨迹利于 LLM 推理与因果分析），但 StepFinder 在 HC 集（22.99%）超过两者，且训练/推理开销远低。

Conclusion: 论文将多智能体故障归因重新形式化为结构化时序建模问题，提出 StepFinder 框架——以 LLM 仅做特征编码，用 BiLSTM + 智能体感知注意力建模时序与跨步交互，再以多尺度差分和位置偏置精炼步级异常分数，配合自监督时间一致性约束。在 Who&When 基准上，StepFinder 在精度、排序质量和推理效率三方面均显著优于 LLM 直接推理方法和通用序列模型，证明将重推理负担从 LLM 转移至专用轻量深度学习架构是可行且高效的方向。论文亦通过消融和超参敏感度分析验证了各模块设计的合理性。

Abstract: LLM-based multi-agent systems exhibit remarkable collaborative capabilities in complex multi-step tasks. However, these systems are highly sensitive to single-step execution errors that can propagate through agent interactions and lead to cascading failures. To understand the causes of failure and improve system reliability, failure attribution has been introduced as a task that aims to automatically identify the root cause step responsible for a failure. Existing failure attribution methods mainly rely on LLMs to reason over original execution trajectories, which not only incur high inference costs and latency, but also suffer from interference caused by redundant and noisy execution logs, causing LLMs to struggle in accurately identifying the true root cause step. To address this, we propose StepFinder, a lightweight failure attribution framework. We use LLMs solely during the feature construction phase to encode execution logs into temporal semantic sequences. Subsequently, a parameter-efficient combination of temporal modeling and attention modules is applied to capture the sequential evolution and cross-step dependencies of the trajectories. Finally, the step-level error score is refined through multi-scale differences and position bias, enabling precise root cause identification. Experimental results on the Who&When benchmark demonstrate that StepFinder outperforms LLM-based methods in step-level failure attribution while achieving substantially higher inference efficiency, reducing inference time by 79% compared with the fastest LLM-based method, with no text generation overhead. Our code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [328] [A formal definition and meta-model for a machine theory of mind](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03471)
*Fabio Cuzzolin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文首次为机器心智理论（Machine Theory of Mind）提出了严格的正式定义，并基于认知心理学、神经科学和人工智能的证据支撑其原则；同时提出了一个整体性元模型（holistic meta-model），并对该领域的实证基准测试现状进行了审视。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前人工智能领域对"机器心智理论"的概念缺乏统一、严格的正式定义，且相关研究分散于多个方向。作者希望填补这一理论空白，为该领域提供清晰的形式化基础，并推动未来研究议程的制定，以期"破解"机器心智理论这一难题。

Method: 本文采用概念形式化与文献综述相结合的方法：(1) 借鉴认知心理学、神经科学及AI领域的实证证据，归纳出心智理论的核心原则；(2) 据此为机器心智理论构建一个严格的形式化定义；(3) 提出一个通用的整体性元模型（holistic meta-model）作为理论框架；(4) 对现有实证基准测试方法进行系统梳理与评估。

Result: 论文的主要贡献包括：(1) 首次给出机器心智理论的严格形式化定义；(2) 提供一个可用于审视和评估当前研究工作的整体性元模型框架；(3) 对领域内最新的研究进展及现有基准测试进行了批判性综述；(4) 提出了一个面向未来研究的潜在研究议程。

Conclusion: 作者认为，通过建立严格的形式化定义和整体性元模型，可以更系统地推进机器心智理论的研究；当前实证基准测试仍存在不足，亟需更全面的评估方法。该工作旨在为AI社区提供理论基石和研究路线图，以期最终在该问题上取得突破。

Abstract: This paper proposes, for the first time, a rigorous formal definition of the concept of Machine Theory of Mind, based on principles supported by evidence from cognitive psychology, neuroscience and artificial intelligence, and uses the above as a lens to examine state-of-the-art and current efforts in the field, driving a potential agenda for further research there able to "crack" the problem. It also advances a general holistic meta-model for Machine Theory of Mind, and examines the state of the art when it comes to empirically benchmarking such models.

</details>


### [329] [ThoughtFold: Folding Reasoning Chains via Introspective Preference Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03503)
*Ziyan Liu,Xueda Shen,Yuzhe Gu,Songyang Gao,Kuikun Liu,Guangran Cheng,Chengqi Lyu,Dahua Lin,Wenwei Zhang,Kai Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出ThoughtFold框架，通过细粒度偏好学习（掩码偏好优化）显式惩罚推理链中的冗余探索，解决大推理模型（LRMs）的"过度思考"问题，使DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B在保持最先进准确率的同时，token使用量减少约56%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RLVR方法基于结果正确性选择CoT轨迹进行记忆，导致长链思维中的冗余试错探索被强化，引发大推理模型的"过度思考"问题。先前方法虽偏好更短轨迹，但学习信号仍为结果导向，无法减少对长CoT中冗余探索的记忆。

Method: 1) 内省策略（introspective strategy）：在每条正确轨迹内识别冗余部分，生成候选子轨迹谱（candidate sub-trajectories）；2) 掩码偏好优化目标（masked preference optimization objective）：显式惩罚冗余探索，鼓励模型直接桥接关键推理段，将推理链"折叠"（fold）成更简洁路径。

Result: 在DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B上token使用减少约56%，同时保持state-of-the-art的准确率。

Conclusion: ThoughtFold通过细粒度偏好学习有效缓解了LRMs的冗余探索问题，在保持推理性能的前提下显著提升效率，验证了在轨迹内部进行结构化偏好优化的有效性。

Abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) have achieved remarkable progress thanks to Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) on Chain-of-Thoughts (CoTs). However, since long CoTs naturally contain trial and errors and mainstream RLVR approaches choose outcome-correct CoT trajectories for memorization, the redundant explorations in long CoTs are inevitably reinforced, which results in the over-thinking issues of LRMs. Previous attempts to resolve this issue mainly give more advantage to shorter trajectories, yet their learning signals are still outcome-based and cannot reduce the memorization of redundant explorations in long CoTs. Therefore, we propose ThoughtFold, a framework that leverages fine-grained preference learning to mitigate redundant explorations for efficient reasoning. ThoughtFold employs an introspective strategy to identify redundancy within each correct trajectory, which yields a spectrum of candidate sub-trajectories. Leveraging this spectrum, we introduce a masked preference optimization objective that explicitly penalizes redundant explorations and encourages the model to directly bridge essential reasoning segments, effectively folding its reasoning chains into a more concise path. Extensive experiments show that ThoughtFold significantly enhances efficiency. It reduces the token usage of DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B by approximately 56% while maintaining state-of-the-art accuracy.

</details>


### [330] [Overlaying Governance: A Compositional Authorization Framework for Delegation and Scope in Agentic AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03518)
*Amjad Ibrahim,Yong Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文针对智能体AI（Agentic AI）系统中传统授权框架（如OAuth 2.0、RBAC）无法处理递归委托、动态作用域和上下文约束的问题，提出了一种基于ReBAC（关系型访问控制）的组合式治理框架。该框架将委托（delegation）和作用域（scope）提升为一等治理原语，通过类型化图重写算子将代理语义以非破坏性方式叠加到现有域授权模型之上，形成可运行时评估的"授权包络"（envelope），并通过形式化证明和大规模基准测试验证了其安全性与实用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着AI系统从被动模型演变为能自主行动、协作和委派任务的主动代理，传统IAM系统的固定主体、显式请求和静态作用域假设不再适用。OAuth 2.0等标准的token机制无法表达递归委托链和动态上下文约束，导致对代理权限的治理不充分，且代理行为不完全预定义、可能受提示注入攻击影响，使得最小权限执行成为智能体系统的核心需求。论文旨在解决如何在不重写现有域授权策略的前提下，为智能体AI引入递归委托、上下文边界和动态作用域等可执行的治理原语。

Method: 1. 将委托定义为法律意义上的"合同性义务转移"，建立包含全权委托、带衰减的作用域委托、条件/上下文委托、深度有界委托、临时委托和组委托等类型的分类体系。
2. 在ReBAC（以OpenFGA/Zanzibar为实现基础）上构建关系模型，引入agent、session、scope等新类型及delegatee、can_execute_on_my_behalf、holder、in_scope、ags_in_scope、chain_agents_for_r、delegated_agent_r等关系，用三因素交集（委托链、活跃作用域、资源作用域归属）定义代理的"授权包络"。
3. 设计一个组合算子，将域模式CD视为类型化图，通过非删除型DPO风格图重写将代理语义叠加上去；适用性条件包括新鲜性、良类型根、根充分性、代理不相交性、良基性和层次兼容性。
4. 提出ACE（Agent Controller Engine）架构，包括治理层、执行层（含授权图和关系写入器）和授权服务，并提供多代理编码助手用例。
5. 形式化证明保守扩展性（领域主体权限不变）和代理授权可靠性（每个代理授权必有合法的人-委托链-作用域见证），以及撤销推论。
6. 在Google Drive和Slack两种企业场景下进行大规模实证评估，对比基线域模型与叠加模型在检查延迟、写入延迟和内存占用上的差异。

Result: 形式化方面：证明了对领域主体保持保守扩展（Lemma 5.1），委托链必然人类根源于合法人类权限（Lemma 5.2），并由此得到代理授权可靠性定理（Theorem 5.3）及撤销推论（Corollary 5.4），即任何代理授权必须同时满足人类权限、委托链和作用域/会话见证三者。
实证方面：在G1–G8（Drive，最大约786k元组，1000用户、500代理）和S1–S5（Slack，最大约387k元组，1200用户、300代理）的基准测试中，检查延迟中位数从域模型的1.97–5.3ms（Drive）和2.0–3.7ms（Slack）增加到叠加模型的2.17–6.83ms（Drive）和2.0–4.47ms（Slack），写入延迟中位数为4.49–9.42ms，内存比在[0.95, 1.2]之间。检查平均延迟比最高为2.20×（G8），但中位数接近1，表明增长可控、适合交互式系统。访问授予率约40%，验证了非平凡的决策分布。结果表明即使无专门优化，中位检查延迟仍低于7ms，具有实时可行性。

Conclusion: 该论文为智能体AI授权提供了一种原则化、可扩展且形式化可验证的组合式治理基础。核心贡献在于：（1）将委托与作用域提升为一等治理原语并给出适合代理的委托类型分类；（2）提出"授权包络"概念以统一表达递归委托链与上下文约束；（3）设计非删除型图重写算子，以保守方式将代理语义叠加到现有ReBAC策略中，无需重写域策略；（4）通过形式化证明和大规模基准测试证明方法既安全又实用。未来工作包括与其他授权模型（如ABAC）的互操作、严格的多策略组合、形式化的作用域衰减处理，以及面向大规模动态代理群体的专用授权图引擎。总体而言，该框架为零信任环境下智能体AI的可问责、可审计和上下文感知授权机制奠定了基础。

Abstract: As AI systems evolve from passive models into autonomous active agents capable of initiating actions, collaborating, and delegating tasks, the traditional boundaries of software systems blur. Traditional authorization and delegation frameworks, built around fixed principals, explicit requests, and static scopes, are insufficient to govern agentic systems. Agentic AI demands richer authorization semantics: agents must inherit and delegate permissions, act under time-limited authority, and coordinate through shared protocols. Existing Identity and Access Management (IAM) systems fail to fully capture this notion of agency, lacking mechanisms for recursive delegation, contextual boundaries, and dynamic scoping as executable governance primitives. Unlike access delegation standards such as OAuth 2.0, we treat delegation as a contractual term rather than merely a static token-based consent credential. This paper proposes a compositional governance framework that introduces primitives indispensable for agentic AI. We define types of delegation and their permissions and accountability implications, and we introduce a notion of resource scope attenuation to bound agentic access envelopes. These concepts are expressed as general relational definitions that can be composed into existing authorization domains (e.g., financial systems). To operationalize this composition, we define a compositional operator that overlays new agentic semantics, such as recursive delegation chains, onto existing relational policies without rewriting them. We substantiate this framework through formal proofs and empirical evaluation, showing that it provides a formal yet practical foundation for accountable authorization in agentic AI systems.

</details>


### [331] [SAGE: A Quantitative Evaluation of Socialized Evolution in Agent Ecosystems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03544)
*Linyue Pan,Yaoming Zhu,Lin Qiu,Xuezhi Cao,Xunliang Cai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SAGE提出了一种计算匹配的评估框架,通过比较SocialEvo(可访问同伴历史的群体共进化)与SelfEvo(仅访问自身历史的独立进化),量化"社会化进化"相对于"自我进化"所能带来的额外增益。在MLR-Bench、DrugWars和Splendor三个竞技场中,用五个不同模型家族的智能体进行实验,发现同伴历史的收益并非普适,而是取决于智能体、竞技场和历史表征方式——过滤后的同伴轨迹和反思性摘要往往优于原始日志。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的自改进语言智能体研究主要在隔离环境中评估个体迭代改进能力,忽视了现实多智能体生态系统中同伴经验(公开轨迹、排行榜、对手策略)所带来的额外学习机会。本文旨在回答一个未被充分研究的问题:共享经验何时能产生自我改进无法实现的提升?需要一种计算匹配的方法来剥离"更多尝试"与"同伴暴露"的效应。

Method: 1) 提出SAGE框架,定义SocialEvo(5个异构模型家族智能体共进化,每轮m次rollout,可访问全部同伴历史)与SelfEvo(焦点智能体独享相同总rollout预算Km,仅看自身历史)进行计算匹配对照。2) 在三个竞技场实例化:MLR-Bench(开放性ML研究,合作型)、DrugWars(长视野经济规划,合作型)、Splendor(多人策略博弈,对抗型)。3) 引入TEG(目标进化增益)和ShadowDrop(模型替换影子测试)用于诊断对手特异性适应。4) 在DrugWars中对五种历史表征模式(完整/无/仅排行榜/Top-1轨迹/摘要)进行消融。运行16轮,使用配对置信区间评估。

Result: 1) 社会化进化不是普适增强器:MLR-Bench中无确认的智能体级增益,DrugWars中出现混合结果——DeepSeek-V3.2(+15,928,CI不跨零)和GPT-5.4(+20,974,CI不跨零)获得显著正收益,而Kimi-K2.5(-113,620)显著受损。2) 静态强度不预测社会增益:DrugWars中SelfEvo表现最好的智能体反而受SocialEvo伤害最大。3) Splendor中TEG和ShadowDrop测试表明DeepSeek对Doubao形成了目标特异性策略(非通用提升)。4) 历史表征消融显示Top-1轨迹和仅排行榜模式优于完整历史,表明抽象/过滤比暴露量更重要。

Conclusion: SAGE证明同伴历史的收益是智能体特异性、竞技场依赖的,取决于从公开轨迹中抽象可迁移知识的能力。核心启示:在共享智能体生态系统中,评估应超越自我改进基线,纳入"是否能过滤、抽象并重用公开经验"的第二阶能力;公共信息设计应注重表征的选择性而非数量,避免将暴露与学习混淆。

Abstract: Self-improving language agents are typically evaluated in isolation: an agent attempts a task, receives feedback, and iteratively refines its own behavior. Yet agents increasingly operate alongside peers whose strategies and outcomes are publicly visible. This raises an under-studied question: when does shared experience produce improvements that self-improvement alone cannot achieve? We introduce SAGE (Social Agent Group Evolution),an evaluation framework that compares two compute-matched conditions: SocialEvo, where agents from five distinct model families co-evolve with access to all peers' histories; and SelfEvo, where each agent receives the same number of task attempts but sees only its own past, which is conventional in self-improving agent studies. We instantiate SAGE in three arenas: open-ended ML research, long-horizon economic planning, and strategic multiplayer play, evaluated across multiple evolutionary rounds. We find that group history is not a universal amplifier: the strongest agent does not exceed its self-evolution ceiling. However, agents that plateau under self-improvement can achieve significant breakthroughs when peer experience is available. In competitive settings, counterfactual controls reveal that agents improve generally rather than developing opponent-specific strategies. Across different forms of shared history, filtered peer traces and reflective summaries often outperform raw logs, indicating that social gains depend on abstraction rather than exposure volume. These findings reveal that peer-history gains are agent-specific, arena-dependent, and contingent on the capacity to abstract transferable knowledge from public traces.

</details>


### [332] [From Prompt to Service: An SLM-Based Agent Orchestration Gateway for AI-Driven Virtual Worlds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03557)
*Louis Nisiotis,Aimilios Hadjiliasi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于小语言模型(SLM)的智能体编排网关(Agent Orchestration Gateway),用于在AI驱动的虚拟世界中协调异构AI后端服务。该网关通过意图驱动的服务路由,将虚拟世界客户端与不同AI后端解耦,并在InterwovenXR虚拟博物馆测试平台中进行了实现与评估,验证了紧凑型SLM作为边缘意图路由器的可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着生成式AI能力扩展,AI驱动的虚拟世界需要协调多种专业化AI服务(对话、翻译、检索、专家解释、3D生成等),但将不同AI能力直接嵌入虚拟世界系统会降低可扩展性、增加维护复杂性、难以协调跨边缘和云端基础设施的分布式服务。现有关于生成式AI在虚拟世界中的研究多关注对话代理或内容生成,缺乏对运行时异构AI服务编排架构的关注。

Method: 设计了一个轻量级Python/FastAPI运行时协调层,包含五个核心组件:(1)虚拟世界客户端,(2)编排网关,(3)基于SLM的意图路由器,(4)服务注册与验证层,(5)后端服务执行层。研究采用两阶段评估方法:Stage 1在500条提示(5类路由各100条)上评估Qwen2.5和SmolLM2系列模型的路由准确性、延迟和无效输出率;Stage 2评估四组分层配置(微调子十亿参数模型作路由器+较大SLM作对话生成器)的端到端延迟。使用4-bit QLoRA在RTX 4060上对SmolLM2-360M和Qwen2.5-0.5B进行微调(5000条路由示例),部署在NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX 8GB边缘设备上。

Result: Stage 1: Qwen2.5-14B参考模型达97.80%准确率(验证数据集可分性);Qwen2.5-1.5B达94.60%、延迟1776.9ms;SmolLM2-1.7B达85.40%、延迟1314.9ms;经微调后Qwen2.5-0.5B-FT准确率从24.80%提升至83.00%(提升58.2%),延迟仅从329.3ms微增至392.0ms;SmolLM2-360M-FT从16.80%提升至49.20%。Stage 2: 4组分层配置均实现低于1.6秒的端到端平均延迟(低于2秒交互阈值),其中SmolLM2-360M-FT配Qwen2.5-1.5B平均延迟最低(1306.06ms),而Qwen2.5系列组合(Qwen2.5-0.5B-FT + Qwen2.5-1.5B)提供最佳平衡(1454.18ms延迟,83%路由准确率)。所有配置在5-7.4GB RAM内可同时加载两个模型。

Conclusion: 研究证明了紧凑型SLM可作为AI驱动虚拟世界中可行的意图识别与服务路由机制;任务特定微调能将子十亿参数模型转化为实用的低延迟边缘路由器;分层配置(微调路由器+较大对话模型)比单一模型同时承担路由和对话生成更高效,可在中端边缘硬件上部署。研究贡献了一种可扩展、可扩展、边缘支持的AI交互架构,使虚拟代理成为分布式生成式AI服务的统一访问点。局限包括:数据集限于单一虚拟博物馆场景、缺乏用户主观评估、模型对特定路由方案过拟合、单一边缘设备测试等。未来工作将探索更小参数模型、困难负样本、多轮对话、用户研究等方向。

Abstract: As generative AI capabilities expand, AI-driven virtual worlds face a growing architectural challenge. Users interact through in-world interfaces in multimodal ways, yet their requests demand fundamentally different AI backend models and computational resources. Embedding these capabilities directly into virtual world systems reduces extensibility, complicates maintenance, and limits the ability to coordinate services distributed across edge and cloud infrastructure. This paper presents an SLM-based Agent Orchestration Gateway, a lightweight runtime coordination mechanism that decouples a virtual world client from heterogeneous AI backends through intent-driven service routing. An edge-deployed SLM classifies the semantic intent of each user prompt, a configurable service registry validates and resolves the routing decision, and the selected backend is invoked transparently, enabling new AI capabilities to be introduced in the virtual world without modifying the client application. The gateway is implemented and evaluated within the InterwovenXR virtual museum testbed. The evaluation shows that compact SLMs can serve as reliable intent routers on edge hardware, and that task-specific fine-tuning can transform sub-billion-parameter models into practical, low-latency routers.
